items.title: Fed暫時不用升息了？通膨降溫讓華許找到觀望理由
items.title_en: Fed May Not Need to Raise Rates Yet? Cooling Inflation Gives Warsh Reason to Hold Back
paras: 美國7月消費者與生產者物價增幅低於預期，加上就業市場降溫，正削弱聯準會(Fed)短期內升息的理由。儘管通膨仍明顯高於2%目標，且決策官員對物價風險看法分歧，近期數據可能促使5月上任的主席華許(Kevin Warsh)帶領Fed維持利率不變，延長按兵不動的時間。
華許接掌Fed時，貨幣政策正處於十字路口。部分官員主張升息以控制通膨，總統川普則不斷要求降息刺激經濟。然而，目前經濟既未明顯朝失業率上升發展，通膨也未重新加速，使Fed缺乏立即採取行動的迫切理由。

通膨降溫讓Fed更有理由等待

美國勞動市場並未蓬勃成長，過去6個月經通膨調整後的實質薪資下降，就業成長也相當疲弱，但失業率仍維持在歷史低檔的4.1%。另一方面，今年初美國與以色列對伊朗的戰爭曾推升能源價格，帶動通膨急遽升高，但過去兩個月物價壓力已逐漸緩和。
Fed偏好的個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數在連續3個月受到戰爭推升能源價格影響後，5月升至4.1%，6月則回落至3.7%。雖然仍遠高於Fed的2%目標，但下降趨勢已削弱「不升息就無法壓低通膨」的論點。
最新數據進一步支持觀望立場。美國7月生產者物價指數(PPI)按月意外持平，消費者物價指數(CPI)也僅微幅上升，且6月曾出現下滑。近期就業意外減少，加上CPI與PPI均低於預期，促使交易員大幅撤回對Fed在9月15日至16日會議升息的押注。
里奇蒙Fed總裁巴金(Thomas Barkin)表示，許多官員認為目前利率水準仍具足夠限制性，可繼續推動通膨下降。近期物價加速很大程度來自關稅提高、油價上漲及人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮等衝擊，而這些因素最終都可能消退。
巴金也指出，媒體、金融市場及民眾將注意力集中在近期通膨降溫，有助於穩定物價預期。只要市場持續接收到「通膨正在下降」的訊息，即使通膨已超過Fed目標逾5年，也可能降低立即升息的必要性。

鷹派憂心高通膨逐漸根深蒂固

不過，部分官員擔心，通膨長時間高於2%可能推升消費者與企業的物價預期，最後形成自我實現的循環。當企業預期未來成本還會上升，便可能提前漲價；消費者若認定高通膨將持續，也可能改變薪資要求與支出行為，使物價壓力更加難以消除。
Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)與庫克(Lisa Cook)近期均表示，若通膨未能迅速降溫，他們將支持升息。克里夫蘭Fed總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)更質疑，若Fed還需要3至4年才能將通膨降至2%，這樣的速度是否可以接受。
哈瑪克是上月反對Fed維持利率在3.50%至3.75%的3名決策官員之一，她主張立即升息。另有兩名今年不具投票權的地區Fed總裁隨後也表示支持升息。
哈瑪克引述辛辛那提一家零售商的說法指出，業者正提前調高售價，因為即使不知道下一波成本壓力來自何處，也相信漲價壓力終將出現。她認為，Fed應立即採取行動，以比目前緩慢下降的路徑更快將通膨拉回2%。
SGH Macro Advisors首席美國經濟學家Tim Duy警告，通膨停留在目前水準愈久，愈可能固化於民眾預期之中。一旦市場不再相信2%目標，Fed日後就必須付出更高代價，採取更強力措施才能重新建立公信力。

升息與不升息各有代價

華許至今未透露下一步政策計畫，也避免提供任何明確前瞻指引。川普則持續要求大幅降息，並指責華許在Fed內部的「敵意」同僚阻擋降息。不過，目前幾乎沒有數據顯示經濟疲弱到需要採取川普期望的降息措施。
Fed面臨的難題是，升息可能透過提高借貸成本壓低經濟活動，甚至推升失業率，而通膨本身可能已在逐步下降；但若持續按兵不動，也可能讓民眾逐漸失去對2%目標的信心。
Fed官員將在9月會議後公布最新經濟與利率預測。截至6月中旬，多數官員預估，PCE通膨將在2027年底降至2.2%至2.5%；但華許的同僚中，只有一半認為今年底前至少需要升息1碼，其餘官員除1人外均認為利率應維持不變，凸顯決策陣營的高度分歧。
Natixis首席美國經濟學家Christopher Hodge表示，未來幾次Fed會議都存在意外升息的可能，但隨通膨緩慢朝目標下降、消費部門降溫，以及就業前景轉趨脆弱，Fed最終應能勉強避免升息。這意味華許領導下的Fed可能既不升息，也不順應川普要求降息，而是在兩種風險之間維持更長時間的觀望。
paras_en: U.S. July consumer and producer price increases came in below expectations, and a cooling labor market is eroding the short‑term case for another Fed rate hike. Even though inflation remains well above the 2% target and policymakers are split on price risks, the latest data could prompt the Fed, led by Chairman Kevin Warsh who took office in May, to keep rates steady and extend the pause.

When Warsh assumed the Fed’s helm, monetary policy was at a crossroads. Some officials advocated raising rates to curb inflation, while President Trump repeatedly called for cuts to spur growth. Yet the economy is not showing a clear rise in unemployment and inflation has not re‑accelerated, leaving the Fed without an urgent trigger to act now.

Cooling inflation gives the Fed more reason to wait. The U.S. labor market is not booming; real wages adjusted for inflation have fallen over the past six months and job growth is weak, though the unemployment rate remains at a historically low 4.1%. Earlier this year, the U.S.–Israel conflict with Iran pushed energy prices higher and spiked inflation, but price pressures have eased over the past two months.

The Fed‑preferred personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index, after three months of war‑driven energy price spikes, rose to 4.1% in May and fell back to 3.7% in June. While still far above the Fed’s 2% goal, the downward trend weakens the argument that “no rate hike means inflation cannot be lowered.”

The latest data further support a wait‑and‑see stance. July’s producer price index (PPI) was unexpectedly flat month‑over‑month, and the consumer price index (CPI) rose only modestly, after a dip in June. Recent weaker‑than‑expected job numbers, combined with CPI and PPI below forecasts, have led traders to pull back bets on a rate hike at the September 15‑16 meeting.

Richmond Fed President Thomas Barkin said many officials believe the current rate level remains sufficiently restrictive to keep inflation falling. Recent price accelerations stem largely from higher tariffs, rising oil prices and an AI investment boom, all of which may eventually recede.

Barkin also noted that media, markets and the public focusing on the recent cooling of inflation helps anchor price expectations. As long as the market continues to receive the message that “inflation is easing,” even though inflation has been above the Fed’s target for more than five years, the urgency for an immediate hike could diminish.

Hawkish officials worry that persistently high inflation could embed higher price expectations among consumers and firms, creating a self‑fulfilling cycle. If firms expect future cost increases, they may raise prices early; if consumers believe high inflation will continue, they may demand higher wages and alter spending, making price pressures harder to eliminate.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller and Lisa Cook recently said they would back a hike if inflation does not cool quickly. Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack went further, questioning whether a three‑ to four‑year timeline to bring inflation down to 2% would be acceptable.

Hammack was one of three voting Fed officials last month who opposed keeping the policy rate in the 3.50%‑3.75% range and advocated an immediate hike. Two other regional Fed presidents without voting rights later also voiced support for a rate increase this year.

Citing a Cincinnati retailer, Hammack said firms are pre‑emptively raising prices because, even if they don’t know the next source of cost pressure, they expect price hikes to come. She argues the Fed should act now to pull inflation back to 2% faster than the current gradual decline.

Tim Duy, chief U.S. economist at SGH Macro Advisors, warned that the longer inflation stays at current levels, the more it can become entrenched in public expectations. If markets stop believing the 2% target is achievable, the Fed will later have to pay a higher price and take stronger measures to restore credibility.

Warsh has not disclosed his next policy move and has avoided giving clear forward guidance. Trump continues to demand large cuts and blames “hostile” colleagues inside the Fed for blocking rate cuts. Yet there is little data suggesting the economy is weak enough to warrant the deep cuts Trump wants.

The Fed’s dilemma is that raising rates could dampen economic activity and lift unemployment while inflation may already be on a downward path; but staying put for too long could erode public confidence in the 2% goal.

Fed officials will release updated economic and rate forecasts after the September meeting. As of mid‑June, most projected PCE inflation to fall to 2.2%‑2.5% by the end of 2027, but only half of Warsh’s colleagues think at least one more 25‑basis‑point hike is needed before year‑end, while the rest, except one, see rates staying unchanged, highlighting deep division.

Christopher Hodge, chief U.S. economist at Natixis, said unexpected hikes remain possible at upcoming Fed meetings, but with inflation slowly edging toward target, consumer demand cooling and a fragile employment outlook, the Fed should ultimately be able to avoid further hikes. This suggests that under Warsh’s leadership the Fed may neither raise rates nor cut them at Trump’s urging, opting instead for an extended period of observation between the two risks.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉零售銷售降溫削弱Fed升息預期！主要指數漲跌互現
paras: 美股主要指數周五(14日)開盤走勢分歧，標普500指數在前一交易日創下收盤新高後變動不大，有望連續第三周收紅。美國7月零售銷售意外下滑，進一步削弱市場對聯準會(Fed)9月升息的押注，但投資人仍密切評估中東局勢與能源價格上漲風險。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近30點或近0.1%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近20點或0.06%，標普 500 指數漲0.02%，費城半導體指數跌近0.6%。台積電 ADR 跌近0.8%。
美股周五盤前維持在歷史高點附近，人工智慧(AI)交易熱度回升，加上最新經濟數據促使市場下調聯準會(Fed)升息預期，支撐風險資產買氣。不過，伊朗局勢與荷姆茲海峽航運風險仍可能推高能源價格，為通膨與市場前景增添變數。
截稿前，標普500指數期貨上漲0.1%，該指數周四甫創下收盤新高；那斯達克100指數期貨上漲0.3%，本周漲幅可望達到1.2%。記憶體業者Sandisk(SNDK-US)獲摩根大通調升評等後，盤前上漲近6%，投資人同時關注OpenAI赴華爾街上市的相關計畫。

AI資金重新湧入科技硬體

科技股本月推動標普500指數屢創新高，投資人重新布局先前遭到拋售的半導體與其他AI概念股。相關企業第二季財報普遍優於市場原本已相當樂觀的預期，使投資焦點重新回到實際營收與獲利成長。
美國銀行(BofA)由Michael Hartnett領軍的策略師團隊表示，市場多頭進一步推升風險資產的「大門已經敞開」，主要支撐因素包括企業獲利飆升、2026年家庭財富增加10兆美元，以及2027年AI資本支出預計超過1兆美元。
被視為AI投資風向球的南韓綜合股價指數(Kospi)周五上漲逾2%，本周累計大漲11%，終止連續7周下跌。三星電子與SK海力士過去5個交易日均上漲逾15%，反映資金重新追捧AI硬體與記憶體類股。
Asset Management One首席策略師Hitoshi Asaoka表示，大量超大規模雲端服務商資金正流入硬體領域，並轉化為硬體公司的強勁營收與獲利成長。投資人因而重新將注意力放在企業基本面，而非只關注AI投資規模與估值疑慮。
貨幣政策預期也為股市提供支撐。美國7月零售銷售創逾一年最大降幅，加上本周公布的消費者與生產者物價數據均較溫和，強化Fed保持耐心的理由。對政策前景敏感的2年期美債殖利率下跌4個基點至4.11%，美元指數則下跌0.4%。

能源與長債殖利率仍藏風險

儘管市場風險偏好回升，能源價格再度推升通膨的威脅並未消失。布蘭特原油周五一度大漲近2%，其後回吐漲幅，降至每桶約87美元。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)表示，美方將對伊朗實施前所未有的「經濟孤立」，並配合持續封鎖伊朗港口，形成雙重打擊。
Plurimi Wealth投資長Patrick Armstrong警告，荷姆茲海峽短期內恐怕無法完全恢復正常運輸，市場對相關風險可能過於自滿。一旦原油供應再受干擾，能源價格上漲可能重新推升通膨，並迫使投資人重新評估Fed政策路徑。
美國周四標售30年期公債的得標殖利率升至25年來最高，也凸顯投資人要求更高的風險溢價，才願意為美國龐大財政赤字提供融資。長天期殖利率居高不下，可能對股票估值構成壓力。
《彭博》策略師Skylar Montgomery Koning指出，市場展現出驚人韌性，夏季行情可能以樂觀氣氛收尾，但表面平靜之下的尾部風險正持續擴大，尤其集中於大宗商品價格上漲、停滯性通膨及長天期債券殖利率攀升。

items.title: 美國7月零售銷售意外下滑0.6% 創逾一年最大跌幅
paras: 美國7月零售銷售意外下滑，月減0.6%，創2025年5月以來最大降幅，遠遜市場預期的月增0.1%，顯示消費者在上半年強勁支出後暫時踩下煞車。除了大筆退稅帶來的一次性刺激逐漸消退，亞馬遜(Amazon)(AMZN-US)將Prime Day促銷活動提前至6月，以及世界盃賽事帶來的消費熱潮降溫，也共同拖累7月數據。
美國商務部人口普查局周五(14日)公布，7月零售銷售月減0.6%，6月則維持月增0.2%不變。零售銷售主要反映商品消費，且未經通膨調整；按年計算，7月銷售額仍成長5%，整體消費尚未陷入全面衰退。

Prime Day提前透支消費動能

13個零售類別中有5類銷售下滑，其中包括亞馬遜在內的非實體店面零售商銷售重挫2.2%，成為整體數據的最大拖累之一。美國銀行(BofA)指出，由於亞馬遜今年將Prime Day由7月提前至6月，其他零售商也同步推出競爭性促銷，使原本應在7月發生的網路購物需求被提前釋放。
汽車及零件經銷商銷售也下滑1.8%，與車廠公布的銷售量減少一致。加油站收入則因汽油價格回落而下降，服飾與家具等類別同樣走弱。分析認為，7月初的熱浪與世界盃結束後的消費降溫，也可能對當月支出造成一定影響。
不過，餐廳和酒吧收入逆勢成長0.5%，顯示服務消費仍具韌性。若排除汽車與汽油，7月零售銷售下滑0.2%。
更值得注意的是，排除餐飲、汽車、建材與加油站的核心零售銷售，也就是最接近國內生產毛額(GDP)商品消費計算的「控制組銷售」，7月下滑0.4%，創2025年初以來最大降幅，明顯不如市場預期的成長0.3%。6月增幅也由原先公布的0.5%下修至0.4%。

退稅紅利消退但財富效應仍在

美國消費者今年稍早獲得較為可觀的退稅，抵銷中東衝突推升汽油價格帶來的衝擊，並支撐第二季消費支出以年率3.2%成長，帶動同期經濟成長1.5%。但經濟學家指出，這項一次性紅利如今大致用盡，加上6月個人儲蓄率降至四年低點，讓下半年消費展望面臨更多不確定性。
美國銀行與PNC Financial的刷卡數據也顯示，在Prime Day與世界盃帶動6月支出後，7月消費成長速度明顯放緩。PNC指出，家庭對汽油價格上漲似乎比年初更加敏感，使下半年消費環境變得較不有利。
不過，多數經濟學家認為7月疲軟可能只是暫時現象。標普500指數今年已上漲14%，股市走高推升家庭財富，尤其愈來愈多高所得與年長家庭正將資產增值轉化為消費。美國銀行也指出，家庭儲蓄仍高於疫情前水準，而且全額繳清信用卡帳單的家庭比率持續增加。
刷卡資料還顯示，過去幾周低所得家庭的消費成長反而高於高所得家庭，即使排除汽油支出也是如此，意味過去高所得者支撐消費、低所得者承壓的「K型經濟」格局可能正在淡化。儘管退稅紅利消退與價格敏感度升高構成風險，但在股市財富效應和家庭財務狀況支撐下，經濟學家仍難以想像美國消費會真正失速。

items.title: 從蘋果到福特都繞不開！中國科技正深入全球企業供應鏈
paras: 儘管華盛頓持續加強對中國科技業的限制，從人工智慧(AI)、電動車到電池供應鏈，中國技術卻日益深入全球大型企業的營運。
蘋果(Apple)(AAPL-US)在中國市場借助阿里巴巴與百度(BIDU-US)(09888-HK)發展AI服務，福特(Ford)(F-US)引進寧德時代(CATL)電池技術；福斯汽車(Volkswagen)則與小鵬汽車(XPEV-US)(09868-HK)合作開發智慧電動車，Stellantis(STLA-US)也擴大與零跑汽車在生產及聯合採購方面的合作。
分析師指出，一場更廣泛的結構性轉變正在發生。中國過去主要是跨國企業銷售商品的市場，如今在部分產業已成為技術、供應鏈能力與創新的來源，全球企業愈來愈難繞開。

中國從銷售市場轉為技術來源

IDC中國區董事總經理Kitty Fok表示，5年前全球企業主要前往中國銷售產品，如今在某些領域，企業前往中國是為了取得技術能力。這項轉變正值美國持續遏制中國科技發展之際。華為2019年遭列入黑名單後，美國陸續限制先進晶片及製造設備出口，並管制對中國半導體、量子科技和AI領域的部分投資，包括中芯國際(SMIC)在內的企業也受到制裁。
然而，中國已在多個科技產業建立難以忽視的地位。Counterpoint Research數據顯示，比亞迪、長安汽車和奇瑞等中國車廠，2025年合計占全球電動車市場近63%；寧德時代、比亞迪、中創新航和國軒高科等電池製造商，市占率更接近70%。
Counterpoint首席分析師Soumen Mandal指出，成本、規模、製造能力、供應鏈整合及創新速度，都是全球企業持續與中國公司合作的重要原因。中國的科技優勢已不再只是低成本製造，而是進一步延伸至龐大產能、完整供應鏈及產品快速迭代，迫使跨國企業在地緣政治風險與商業現實之間尋求平衡。
這項轉變在電動車電池領域尤其明顯。福特正利用寧德時代的磷酸鐵鋰電池技術，在密西根州興建規模35億美元的電池廠。Fok表示，供應商更換不是一季內就能完成的採購決策，還須經過多年工程設計、測試與重新認證，因此中國電池技術一旦嵌入全球供應鏈便很難抽離。
部分合作則主要是為了在中國市場維持競爭力。由於外國供應商受到限制，在中國營運且需要AI或雲端基礎設施的跨國企業，通常必須採用當地服務，蘋果與阿里巴巴、百度合作便是其中一例。Omdia首席分析師Lian Jye Su指出，進入中國市場仍是許多合作案的主要動力，但電池、電動車、儲能及應用型AI領域也正出現緩慢而持續的供應鏈與創新重組。

AI成為下一個競爭前線

中國技術的影響力也開始向AI擴散。IDC今年稍早調查歐洲企業發現，廣泛採用中國AI模型的兩大原因，分別是安全及法規遵循要求，以及更優異的性能，成本反而不是首要考量。Fok認為，西方企業採用中國AI並非單純因為價格較低，而是由模型表現驅動，再以安全與合規條件把關。
有別於美國的Anthropic與OpenAI，阿里巴巴(BABA-US)(09988-HK)、DeepSeek等中國企業較積極發展開放原始碼模型，使全球開發者更容易取得及部署。Su表示，美國限制雖壓縮中國取得尖端半導體的能力，卻也成為推動中國本土創新與效率提升的催化劑，使中國供應商在AI、電池及汽車軟體方面仍具競爭力。
不過，中國技術並非會在所有領域暢行無阻。先進半導體、網路安全、國防及涉及國家安全的服務，預料仍將面臨最強烈阻力。分析師認為，未來不會是全面封殺或全面接受，而是依產業採取不同立場。中國技術可望持續擴展至電動車、電池、消費電子、機器人、無人機，以及部分AI與半導體領域，形成更分裂、但也更務實的全球科技生態。

items.title: 友達400億聯貸爆搶！一銀、臺銀聯手統籌主辦23家銀行「砸錢」超額認購2.62倍
items.title_en: FPI's NT$400 Billion Syndicated Loan Attracts 23 Banks, Oversubscribed by 2.62 Times
paras: 面板大廠友達光電（2409-TW）獲金融圈力挺。由第一銀行與臺灣銀行共同統籌主辦的友達光電5年期新台幣400億元聯合授信案今（14）日完成簽約，由於市場反應熱烈，共吸引23家金融機構參與，最終承諾授信金額高達1,048億元，超額認貸達2.62倍，不僅遠超原定募資規模，也展現銀行團對友達經營實力與未來發展前景的高度信心。
此次聯貸案由第一銀行及臺灣銀行擔任統籌主辦暨管理銀行，資金用途包括償還既有金融負債、充實中期營運周轉金，以及採購再生能源與綠電憑證。據悉，本案自啟動募集至完成籌組歷時不到兩個月，在金融同業踴躍參貸下快速完成，顯示市場資金對國內科技產業龍頭企業仍具高度支持力度。
友達近年積極推動轉型策略，從傳統面板製造商朝光電解決方案供應商邁進，以顯示科技為核心，發展高值化產品及系統整合服務。目前營運聚焦三大策略主軸，包括顯示科技（Display）、智慧移動（Mobility Solutions）及垂直場域（Vertical Solutions），透過多元布局提升營運韌性與獲利能力。
在智慧移動領域，友達近年完成德國汽車一級供應商併購，並透過子公司友達智慧移動切入全球車廠供應鏈，布局智慧座艙、車載顯示及整合解決方案市場，搶攻車用電子快速成長商機。另一方面，旗下達擎（AUO Display Plus）則深耕智慧醫療、智慧零售、企業應用及教育市場，持續擴大垂直場域布局。
面對AI浪潮席捲全球，友達也成立「創新研究院」，作為集團前瞻技術與創新應用研發平台，推動AI技術導入產品與服務，加速研發成果商業化，藉此提升集團長期競爭力與營運成長動能。
除了轉型成果受到市場關注，友達在永續發展上的表現同樣獲得國際肯定。友達為全球顯示器產業首家加入RE100倡議的企業，並率先承諾於2050年全面使用再生能源。近年公司接連獲得多項國際ESG評比肯定，包括躋身S&P Global永續年鑑全球前5%企業、獲CDP雙A評級，最新MSCI ESG評等亦由A級調升至AA級，展現在環境治理與企業永續經營方面的成果。
公司治理方面，友達已連續多年名列台灣證券交易所公司治理評鑑前5%，並獲得企業永續獎及友善家庭職場獎等殊榮，持續強化品牌形象與國際競爭力。
作為本案共同統籌主辦銀行的第一銀行，近年積極耕耘科技產業融資市場，包括AI、半導體及電子供應鏈等重點產業皆有深度布局。根據市場統計，第一銀行2026年上半年於國內聯貸市場主辦銀行（MLA）排名第一、管理銀行（Bookrunner）排名第二，持續穩居市場領先地位。第一銀行表示，未來將持續透過聯貸與多元金融服務支持企業創新升級及永續轉型，發揮金融業資金媒合功能，協助企業掌握AI與綠色經濟發展商機。
市場人士分析，在面板產業景氣逐步回穩、車用及AI應用需求持續擴增之際，友達積極推動雙軸轉型與高附加價值布局，已逐步獲得資本市場及銀行團肯定。此次400億元聯貸案獲得超過千億元資金響應，不僅反映金融業對友達營運體質的認同，也顯示市場看好其在智慧移動、AI應用及永續轉型等新成長引擎的長期發展潛力。
paras_en: FPI (2409-TW) has received strong support from the financial sector. The NT$400 billion 5-year syndicated loan, jointly organized and managed by First Bank and Taiwan Bank, was completed on August 14, with 23 financial institutions participating, resulting in a total committed amount of NT$1,048 billion, exceeding the original target of NT$400 billion by 2.62 times.

This syndicated loan was organized by First Bank and Taiwan Bank, with a total of 23 financial institutions participating. The funds will be used to repay existing financial debts, replenish working capital, and purchase renewable energy and green certificates. According to sources, the entire process took less than two months, demonstrating the strong support for domestic technology industry leaders.

FPI has been actively promoting its transformation strategy in recent years, shifting from traditional panel manufacturing to becoming a leading provider of display solutions. The company has focused on three main strategies: Display, Mobility Solutions, and Vertical Solutions, and has diversified its operations to enhance its resilience and profitability.

In the Mobility Solutions sector, FPI has completed the acquisition of a German automotive Tier 1 supplier and has entered the global automotive supply chain through its subsidiary, FPI Mobility Solutions. The company has also expanded its presence in the intelligent cockpit, automotive display, and integrated solution markets.

In addition to its transformation efforts, FPI has established the 'Innovation Research Institute' to drive the development of AI technology and its applications. This will enable the company to accelerate the commercialization of its research and development results, enhancing its long-term competitiveness and growth momentum.

FPI's transformation efforts have received international recognition, with the company being the first display industry player to join the RE100 initiative and committing to using 100% renewable energy by 2050. The company has also received numerous international ESG ratings, including being ranked among the top 5% of companies in the S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook and receiving a double A rating from CDP.

In terms of corporate governance, FPI has consistently ranked among the top 5% of companies in the Taiwan Stock Exchange's corporate governance evaluation and has received awards such as the Enterprise Sustainability Award and the Friendly Family Workplace Award. The company continues to strengthen its brand image and international competitiveness.

As one of the joint organizers of the syndicated loan, First Bank has been actively cultivating the technology industry financing market, including AI, semiconductors, and electronic supply chains. According to market statistics, First Bank ranked first in the MLA (Managing Loan Agent) and second in the Bookrunner rankings in the first half of 2026, maintaining its leading position in the market.

Market analysts believe that FPI's dual-axis transformation and high-value-added layout have gained recognition from the capital market and banking sector. The NT$400 billion syndicated loan, which attracted over NT$1 trillion in responses, reflects the financial sector's recognition of FPI's operational capabilities and demonstrates the market's optimism about its long-term growth potential in the fields of intelligent mobility, AI applications, and sustainable transformation.

items.title: 貿協發布2026首輪經貿指數 半數受地緣動盪推升成本、7成7以上台企加速分散供應鏈
paras: 貿協今(14)日公布今(2026)年第一輪「貿協經貿指數」結果，發現在美伊中東戰事引發的地緣政治衝擊下，調查顯示超過半數企業約56.2%受負面波及。為因應國際地緣經濟變局與成本挑戰，企業積極擁抱「數位轉型」與「AI賦能」的企業展現了高度的營運韌性，也對未來景氣預期與抗壓性優於尚未轉型的同業。
調查中，受美伊中東戰事波及，高達56.2%的企業評估整體影響為「負面」，據調查顯示，地緣政治引發的連鎖效應已超越純粹的經濟波動，企業對「營運成本」的風險關注度自前次調查的67.7% 顯著攀升10個百分點至77.5%，高居各項風險指標之冠。
在受衝擊的企業中，高達85.4% 將「成本上升」視為最核心的痛點，其次為「原物料或零件短缺」(49.9%)，面對推升的財務負擔與可能持續半年以上的斷鏈挑戰，企業為妥善因應，應對策略除了持續聚焦「強化產品性價競爭力」外，更積極加速「分散供應鏈及市場」及「調整商業模式」，藉此規避戰事物流風險並尋求突圍。
今年因科技業一枝獨秀，傳統原物料淪為重災區。貿協指出，據本期調查發現，企業對當下外銷環境的「信心指數」落入36.05的低迷區間，但對未來半年的「預期指數」則回升至45.25，顯示企業雖短期承壓，但預期最壞情況可能即將過去，呈現審慎復甦態勢。
值得注意的是，產業間存在極大「溫差」：受惠於全球AI與半導體熱潮，電子、資通訊與光學產業未來預期指數高達53.7，為全產業唯一突破50榮枯線的強勢板塊；反觀石油化學橡塑膠與基本金屬等傳統原物料產業，受地緣衝突導致的成本波動影響最深，預期指數僅落在33.8與30.3，成為本次變局中的重災區。
此次調查中，也顯示AI導入深度與外銷信心呈現高度正相關，進一步深挖企業AI導入現狀，發現絕大多數企業已開始使用AI，但仍有高達42.2%停留在「免費聊天AI」階段，且實質可量化效益仍待突破。
據調查，也揭露關鍵洞察，企業導入AI的深度與其對未來的外銷信心具備強烈正相關，已編列預算進行「AI Agents(代理)」導入的先驅企業，未來預期指數高達59.41；採用「付費AI Agent」的企業亦達51.84，反觀僅使用免費聊天AI或完全未使用的企業，信心指數則低迷在40.9至42.3間，印證了面對宏觀地緣經濟波動，能有效利用AI賦能並控管成本的企業，更具備應對變局的底氣。
貿協指出，今年第一輪調查突顯台企在美伊戰事與地緣政治持續衝擊下，仍展現高度的營運韌性，面對戰局推升營運成本的挑戰，企業的策略出現靈活轉變，將「強化產品性價競爭力」與「分散供應鏈及市場」作為首要之務。
儘管短期承壓，仍有具備韌性的企業能逆勢透過危機「開拓新市場」(48.7%)或「獲得轉單」(34.4%)展望未來3年，美國(56.4%)與東南亞及南亞(52.2%)依然是台企最為看好的目標市場。
貿協指出，誠如數據，將創新科技、市場靈活度與核心優勢三者緊密結合，並提升對多元風險的應變能力，是台企突圍的關鍵，積極擁抱數位轉型與 AI 賦能，已成為應對宏觀經濟波動與地緣政治風險的最佳防禦策略。
貿協推出「貿協經貿指數」(TAITRA INDEX)，提供一項洞察全球市場趨勢的關鍵工具。透過貿協的國內外商情網路，解析即時、可靠的第一手資訊，協助產官學界迅速掌握全球市場動態。此次調查於美伊中東戰事後執行，調查對象涵蓋具代表性之國內外台灣企業主與高階經理人，共回收有效問卷1,678份。

items.title: 鎧俠巨額回購帶動 日本企業單周買超額創歷史新高
paras: 根據日本交易所集團(JPX)周五(14日)公布的投資部門別買賣動向，8月第一周(3日至7日)，日本企業於股市的淨買超額達到1兆882億5,799萬日元，創下歷史最高紀錄。此一數據大幅超越了2015年12月第一周創下的7,612億日元舊紀錄，顯示出日本企業界極為強勁的入市力道。
推動這一歷史性增長的關鍵因素，是半導體記憶體大廠鎧俠控股(Kioxia Holdings)實施的大規模庫藏股回購。為了提高資本效率並充實股東回饋，鎧俠於7月31日宣布設立上限達8,000億日元的庫藏股回購框架。
儘管原定取得期間至10月底，但鎧俠實際上在8月3日至10日的短短一周內，便在市場內完成了約8,000億日元的回購。
東海東京情報實驗室(Tokai Tokyo Intelligence Lab)分析師Shota Sando指出，在如此短的時間內進行如此大規模的回購，在過去「前所未見」。然而，儘管有這筆巨額買盤支撐，鎧俠當周股價僅小幅上漲2.6%至2.7%，分析師認為這顯示市場的賣壓依然相當強勁。
鎧俠股價雖然自今年6月的峰值回落約一半，但今年以來累計漲幅仍超過400%。
在其他投資部門方面，海外投資者於現貨市場連續兩周呈現賣超，金額達3,827億日元；個人投資者也連續三周賣超約1,566億日元。不過，若加計期貨市場，海外投資者整體轉為買超。
在企業的強力支撐下，日經平均指數當周終場上漲1,244.69點，漲幅約1.9%。

items.title: 神基下半年營運續強 無人機專案暴增手握歐美、中東大客戶
paras: 神基控股(3005-TW)今(14)日召開法說，董事長黃明漢表示，下半年營運估優於上半年，動能來自強固型電腦、車用機構件等，全年維持營收成長5%至10%的目標；無人機地面控制站(GCS)解決方案則掌握歐美、中東等地的大型指標客戶，明年佔強固型電腦營收比重約8-12%。
黃明漢表示，神基將強固型筆電、平板與地面控制站整合，並結合無線通訊模組等，與系統整合商(SI)密切合作，打造更勝一籌的商業模式，「神基如果說是老二，沒有人敢說是老大」，特殊的商模也讓潛在商機有更高的機率轉換到實際業務貢獻，今年潛在客戶已較去年增加逾10倍。
針對營運展望，黃明漢表示，強固型電腦成長動能正向，全年仍維持20-30%的成長預期，目前AI強固型電腦也獲客戶高度興趣，初期從軍警相關應用布局，後續可望拓展至其他領域，而因應記憶體等零組件漲價，強固型電腦上半年已漲價20-30%，第三季到第四季可能再漲5-10%。
與筆電相關的綜合機構件今年預估衰退8-12%，目前表現仍落在原先預期區間，但下半年已出現回溫跡象，主要是電競、遊戲機等成長，另外，碳纖機構件也獲兩家品牌客戶採用，預計第四季開始出貨；
車用機構件受惠產線自動化效益顯現，全年成長可望高於原先預估的10-16%，並切入高附加價值新應用，Domain Controller表面處理產品預計第四季開始出貨給Tier 1客戶，由於單價較既有產品高出3到5倍，後續規模擴大將有助車用機構件業績表現。

items.title: 友達400億聯貸爆搶！一銀、臺銀聯手統籌主辦23家銀行「砸錢」超額認購2.62倍
items.title_en: FPI's NT$400 Billion Syndicated Loan Attracts 23 Banks, Oversubscribed by 2.62 Times
paras: 面板大廠友達光電（2409-TW）獲金融圈力挺。由第一銀行與臺灣銀行共同統籌主辦的友達光電5年期新台幣400億元聯合授信案今（14）日完成簽約，由於市場反應熱烈，共吸引23家金融機構參與，最終承諾授信金額高達1,048億元，超額認貸達2.62倍，不僅遠超原定募資規模，也展現銀行團對友達經營實力與未來發展前景的高度信心。
此次聯貸案由第一銀行及臺灣銀行擔任統籌主辦暨管理銀行，資金用途包括償還既有金融負債、充實中期營運周轉金，以及採購再生能源與綠電憑證。據悉，本案自啟動募集至完成籌組歷時不到兩個月，在金融同業踴躍參貸下快速完成，顯示市場資金對國內科技產業龍頭企業仍具高度支持力度。
友達近年積極推動轉型策略，從傳統面板製造商朝光電解決方案供應商邁進，以顯示科技為核心，發展高值化產品及系統整合服務。目前營運聚焦三大策略主軸，包括顯示科技（Display）、智慧移動（Mobility Solutions）及垂直場域（Vertical Solutions），透過多元布局提升營運韌性與獲利能力。
在智慧移動領域，友達近年完成德國汽車一級供應商併購，並透過子公司友達智慧移動切入全球車廠供應鏈，布局智慧座艙、車載顯示及整合解決方案市場，搶攻車用電子快速成長商機。另一方面，旗下達擎（AUO Display Plus）則深耕智慧醫療、智慧零售、企業應用及教育市場，持續擴大垂直場域布局。
面對AI浪潮席捲全球，友達也成立「創新研究院」，作為集團前瞻技術與創新應用研發平台，推動AI技術導入產品與服務，加速研發成果商業化，藉此提升集團長期競爭力與營運成長動能。
除了轉型成果受到市場關注，友達在永續發展上的表現同樣獲得國際肯定。友達為全球顯示器產業首家加入RE100倡議的企業，並率先承諾於2050年全面使用再生能源。近年公司接連獲得多項國際ESG評比肯定，包括躋身S&P Global永續年鑑全球前5%企業、獲CDP雙A評級，最新MSCI ESG評等亦由A級調升至AA級，展現在環境治理與企業永續經營方面的成果。
公司治理方面，友達已連續多年名列台灣證券交易所公司治理評鑑前5%，並獲得企業永續獎及友善家庭職場獎等殊榮，持續強化品牌形象與國際競爭力。
作為本案共同統籌主辦銀行的第一銀行，近年積極耕耘科技產業融資市場，包括AI、半導體及電子供應鏈等重點產業皆有深度布局。根據市場統計，第一銀行2026年上半年於國內聯貸市場主辦銀行（MLA）排名第一、管理銀行（Bookrunner）排名第二，持續穩居市場領先地位。第一銀行表示，未來將持續透過聯貸與多元金融服務支持企業創新升級及永續轉型，發揮金融業資金媒合功能，協助企業掌握AI與綠色經濟發展商機。
市場人士分析，在面板產業景氣逐步回穩、車用及AI應用需求持續擴增之際，友達積極推動雙軸轉型與高附加價值布局，已逐步獲得資本市場及銀行團肯定。此次400億元聯貸案獲得超過千億元資金響應，不僅反映金融業對友達營運體質的認同，也顯示市場看好其在智慧移動、AI應用及永續轉型等新成長引擎的長期發展潛力。
paras_en: FPI (2409-TW) has received strong support from the financial sector. The NT$400 billion 5-year syndicated loan, jointly organized and managed by First Bank and Taiwan Bank, was completed on August 14, with 23 financial institutions participating, resulting in a total committed amount of NT$1,048 billion, exceeding the original target of NT$400 billion by 2.62 times.

This syndicated loan was organized by First Bank and Taiwan Bank, with a total of 23 financial institutions participating. The funds will be used to repay existing financial debts, replenish working capital, and purchase renewable energy and green certificates. According to sources, the entire process took less than two months, demonstrating the strong support for domestic technology industry leaders.

FPI has been actively promoting its transformation strategy in recent years, shifting from traditional panel manufacturing to becoming a leading provider of display solutions. The company has focused on three main strategies: Display, Mobility Solutions, and Vertical Solutions, and has diversified its operations to enhance its resilience and profitability.

In the Mobility Solutions sector, FPI has completed the acquisition of a German automotive Tier 1 supplier and has entered the global automotive supply chain through its subsidiary, FPI Mobility Solutions. The company has also expanded its presence in the intelligent cockpit, automotive display, and integrated solution markets.

In addition to its transformation efforts, FPI has established the 'Innovation Research Institute' to drive the development of AI technology and its applications. This will enable the company to accelerate the commercialization of its research and development results, enhancing its long-term competitiveness and growth momentum.

FPI's transformation efforts have received international recognition, with the company being the first display industry player to join the RE100 initiative and committing to using 100% renewable energy by 2050. The company has also received numerous international ESG ratings, including being ranked among the top 5% of companies in the S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook and receiving a double A rating from CDP.

In terms of corporate governance, FPI has consistently ranked among the top 5% of companies in the Taiwan Stock Exchange's corporate governance evaluation and has received awards such as the Enterprise Sustainability Award and the Friendly Family Workplace Award. The company continues to strengthen its brand image and international competitiveness.

As one of the joint organizers of the syndicated loan, First Bank has been actively cultivating the technology industry financing market, including AI, semiconductors, and electronic supply chains. According to market statistics, First Bank ranked first in the MLA (Managing Loan Agent) and second in the Bookrunner rankings in the first half of 2026, maintaining its leading position in the market.

Market analysts believe that FPI's dual-axis transformation and high-value-added layout have gained recognition from the capital market and banking sector. The NT$400 billion syndicated loan, which attracted over NT$1 trillion in responses, reflects the financial sector's recognition of FPI's operational capabilities and demonstrates the market's optimism about its long-term growth potential in the fields of intelligent mobility, AI applications, and sustainable transformation.

items.title: 貿協發布2026首輪經貿指數 半數受地緣動盪推升成本、7成7以上台企加速分散供應鏈
paras: 貿協今(14)日公布今(2026)年第一輪「貿協經貿指數」結果，發現在美伊中東戰事引發的地緣政治衝擊下，調查顯示超過半數企業約56.2%受負面波及。為因應國際地緣經濟變局與成本挑戰，企業積極擁抱「數位轉型」與「AI賦能」的企業展現了高度的營運韌性，也對未來景氣預期與抗壓性優於尚未轉型的同業。
調查中，受美伊中東戰事波及，高達56.2%的企業評估整體影響為「負面」，據調查顯示，地緣政治引發的連鎖效應已超越純粹的經濟波動，企業對「營運成本」的風險關注度自前次調查的67.7% 顯著攀升10個百分點至77.5%，高居各項風險指標之冠。
在受衝擊的企業中，高達85.4% 將「成本上升」視為最核心的痛點，其次為「原物料或零件短缺」(49.9%)，面對推升的財務負擔與可能持續半年以上的斷鏈挑戰，企業為妥善因應，應對策略除了持續聚焦「強化產品性價競爭力」外，更積極加速「分散供應鏈及市場」及「調整商業模式」，藉此規避戰事物流風險並尋求突圍。
今年因科技業一枝獨秀，傳統原物料淪為重災區。貿協指出，據本期調查發現，企業對當下外銷環境的「信心指數」落入36.05的低迷區間，但對未來半年的「預期指數」則回升至45.25，顯示企業雖短期承壓，但預期最壞情況可能即將過去，呈現審慎復甦態勢。
值得注意的是，產業間存在極大「溫差」：受惠於全球AI與半導體熱潮，電子、資通訊與光學產業未來預期指數高達53.7，為全產業唯一突破50榮枯線的強勢板塊；反觀石油化學橡塑膠與基本金屬等傳統原物料產業，受地緣衝突導致的成本波動影響最深，預期指數僅落在33.8與30.3，成為本次變局中的重災區。
此次調查中，也顯示AI導入深度與外銷信心呈現高度正相關，進一步深挖企業AI導入現狀，發現絕大多數企業已開始使用AI，但仍有高達42.2%停留在「免費聊天AI」階段，且實質可量化效益仍待突破。
據調查，也揭露關鍵洞察，企業導入AI的深度與其對未來的外銷信心具備強烈正相關，已編列預算進行「AI Agents(代理)」導入的先驅企業，未來預期指數高達59.41；採用「付費AI Agent」的企業亦達51.84，反觀僅使用免費聊天AI或完全未使用的企業，信心指數則低迷在40.9至42.3間，印證了面對宏觀地緣經濟波動，能有效利用AI賦能並控管成本的企業，更具備應對變局的底氣。
貿協指出，今年第一輪調查突顯台企在美伊戰事與地緣政治持續衝擊下，仍展現高度的營運韌性，面對戰局推升營運成本的挑戰，企業的策略出現靈活轉變，將「強化產品性價競爭力」與「分散供應鏈及市場」作為首要之務。
儘管短期承壓，仍有具備韌性的企業能逆勢透過危機「開拓新市場」(48.7%)或「獲得轉單」(34.4%)展望未來3年，美國(56.4%)與東南亞及南亞(52.2%)依然是台企最為看好的目標市場。
貿協指出，誠如數據，將創新科技、市場靈活度與核心優勢三者緊密結合，並提升對多元風險的應變能力，是台企突圍的關鍵，積極擁抱數位轉型與 AI 賦能，已成為應對宏觀經濟波動與地緣政治風險的最佳防禦策略。
貿協推出「貿協經貿指數」(TAITRA INDEX)，提供一項洞察全球市場趨勢的關鍵工具。透過貿協的國內外商情網路，解析即時、可靠的第一手資訊，協助產官學界迅速掌握全球市場動態。此次調查於美伊中東戰事後執行，調查對象涵蓋具代表性之國內外台灣企業主與高階經理人，共回收有效問卷1,678份。

items.title: 證交所：Q2財報申報截止 僅凌巨一家未如期出具
items.title_en: TWSE: Q2 Financial Report Filing Deadline, Only Lingju Technology Misses the Deadline
paras: 臺灣證券交易所表示，本國上市公司(不含金融保險公司)應於今(14)日完成2026年第2季財務報告申報。本次應申報的 961 家公司中，除面板廠凌巨科技(8105-TW)無法如期申報外，其餘 960 家均已順利完成作業。
證交所指出，32 家金融保險公司之申報期限則為 8 月 31 日。證交所特別提醒投資人，進行股票交易前應充分了解公司財務狀況，相關財務報告及電子書均可至「公開資訊觀測站」查詢下載。
聚奕投資與日商凸版延宕 10 個月的 34.65% 股權交割已於 6 月下旬完成，凌巨不僅在 6 月底董事會推選前友達全球營運執行副總向富棋接任新董事長，更順應股東會決議預計於今年 9 月 30 日前召開股東臨時會全面改選董事。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange said that domestic listed companies (excluding financial and insurance firms) must complete filing their 2026 Q2 financial reports by today (the 14th). Of the 961 companies required to file, all 960 have successfully completed the process except panel manufacturer Lingju Technology (8105‑TW), which was unable to file on time.

The exchange noted that the filing deadline for the 32 financial and insurance companies is August 31. It reminded investors to fully understand a company's financial condition before trading stocks, and that the relevant financial reports and e‑books can be accessed and downloaded from the Market Observation Post System.

Juyi Investment and Japan's Toppan completed the delayed 34.65% share transfer—delayed by ten months—in late June. Lingju not only appointed former AU Optronics Global Operations Executive Vice President Fu Qi as the new chairman at the board meeting at the end of June, but also, in line with the shareholders’ meeting resolution, plans to convene an extraordinary shareholders’ meeting before September 30 this year to conduct a full board re‑election.

items.title: 走出分家陣痛期！郭添貴掌一卡通提二大策略 「公私協力經驗」開創新局
items.title_en: Breaking Free from the Separation Pains! Guo Tiangui Takes the Helm of One Card and Unveils Two Major Strategies
paras: 高雄市政府前秘書長郭添貴出任一卡通票證公司董事長短短四天，便展現驚人行動力，甚至一天排滿五個行程，他今(14)日特別由高雄北上與媒體茶敘，首度對外暢談一卡通未來的發展策略與營運願景。面對與 LINE Pay 分家後的營運轉型，郭添貴喊出「精準行銷」與「新創生態系」二大策略，並將積極深化社福二代卡與多元生活場域。最新數據顯示，電支 7 月代收付金額已強勁回溫至 23.7 億元，展現獨立營運後的強韌成長力道。
郭添貴資歷完整，歷任交通部航港局局長、台灣港務公司總經理、高雄港區土地開發公司董事長及高市府文化局副局長等要職。郭添貴今天受訪時指出，自己是從亞哥花園出身，曾任研發部、工程部經理，過去長期負責組織協調、預算編列及與民間企業合作，如駁二藝術特區經營、演唱會經濟等，對行銷與市調並不陌生，未來將把這些經驗無縫接軌至一卡通。
對於上半年較高的行銷支出與補貼策略，郭添貴指出，一卡通目前總會員數已突破 725 萬戶，APP 下載數近 400 萬、月活躍用戶近 200 萬。上任後，他主張推動「精準行銷」，全面盤點行銷預算，聚焦於帶動使用者活躍度(包含繳費、消費與生活場域等)，同時也會靈活調整效益不佳的活動，把資源用在刀口上。
針對外界關心的增資進度，郭添貴指出，目前增資流程非常順利地進行中，預計年底前會向大眾報告，且並不會有外部新股東加入。
展望未來，他強調，會持續深化政府政策與擴大新創生態系，儲值卡業務方面，除了既有交通優勢，將積極響應政府政策(如超高齡社會需求)，推動「社福二代卡」，整合搭車、探病、生活購物等多功能，讓長輩能透過 APP 輕鬆管理與檢視帳戶剩餘額度。
此外，一卡通也與綠色出行合作，目標未來將驗票硬體設備擴展至 10 萬台，深化生活場域覆蓋率。
電子支付部分，會積極攜手跨界夥伴，如應援科技、Flexii、WeMo 共享機車、精誠資訊等，透過新創業務突破過去僅限於交通的既定印象，帶動交易金額與筆數大幅成長。

一卡通上半年虧損收斂歸功於票證 電支7月代收付衝上23.7億元

一卡通近日揭露上半年財報，總經理鄭鎧尹說明，上半年虧損顯著縮減，主要得益於票證業務表現強勁、大幅優於預期，成功彌補了與 LINE Pay 拆分後獨立營運的相關成本與行銷投入。他強調，虧損縮減並非來自削減資源，相反地，在董事會全力支持下，一卡通今年採取積極擴張策略，加大對電子支付與生態系的行銷投資。
對於外界關心的獨立營運初期代收付金額變化，鄭鎧尹指出，過去與 LINE Pay 合作時單月最高交易金額約 41 億元，雖然拆分後經歷調整期，但獨立營運不到半年時間，業績已迅速回升。
根據最新統計，一卡通電子支付的使用者戶數在 7 月升至 7,253,660 人；而在交易金額(代收付)方面，已從 6 月的約 18.3 億元，於 7 月顯著回溫增長至約 23.7 億元，單月增加近 5.4 億元，恢復至過往高峰期的一半以上，展現極強的回升韌性。
paras_en: Guo Tiangui, former secretary-general of Kaohsiung City Government, has made a remarkable impact in just four days as the chairman of One Card, even scheduling five events in one day. He met with the media in Taipei today (14th) to discuss One Card's future development strategies and operational vision. In the face of post-separation operational transformation, Guo Tiangui emphasized the importance of 'precise marketing' and 'new ecosystem' as his two major strategies, and will actively deepen the integration of social welfare and multi-lifestyle platforms.

Guo Tiangui has a rich background, having held various key positions such as Director-General of the Ministry of Transportation and Communications, President of Taiwan Port Corporation, Chairman of Kaohsiung Port Area Development Corporation, and Vice-Chairman of Kaohsiung City Cultural Affairs Bureau. During the interview, Guo Tiangui mentioned that he came from the Aigo Garden, and previously served as the manager of the Research and Development Department and Engineering Department. He has long been responsible for organizing coordination, budgeting, and cooperating with private enterprises, such as the operation of the Cijin Art District and concert economy, and is not unfamiliar with marketing and market research. He will integrate these experiences seamlessly into One Card in the future.

Regarding the high marketing expenses and subsidy strategies in the first half of the year, Guo Tiangui pointed out that One Card currently has a total of over 7.25 million members, with over 4 million downloads of the APP and nearly 2 million monthly active users. After taking office, he advocated for 'precise marketing', comprehensively reviewing marketing budgets, focusing on driving user engagement (including payment, consumption, and lifestyle platforms), and will also flexibly adjust the effectiveness of activities, allocating resources to where they are most needed.

Regarding the progress of the capital increase, Guo Tiangui pointed out that the capital increase process is currently proceeding smoothly, and it is expected to report to the public by the end of the year. Moreover, there will be no new external shareholders joining.

Looking to the future, he emphasized that One Card will continue to deepen government policies and expand the new ecosystem, and in the field of stored-value cards, in addition to the existing transportation advantages, it will actively respond to government policies (such as the needs of super-aged society) and promote the 'social welfare second-generation card', integrating multiple functions such as transportation, visiting, and shopping, allowing seniors to easily manage and view their account balances through the APP.
In addition, One Card has also cooperated with Green Travel, aiming to expand the validation hardware equipment to 100,000 units in the future, and deepen the coverage rate of lifestyle platforms.

In the electronic payment sector, it will actively collaborate with cross-industry partners such as Aid Technology, Flexii, WeMo, and Precision Information, breaking through the traditional impression of only being limited to transportation, and driving a significant increase in transaction amounts and numbers.

One Card's first-half loss was significantly reduced, mainly due to the strong performance of the ticketing business, which exceeded expectations, successfully offsetting the related costs and marketing investments of independent operation after separation from LINE Pay.

Regarding the concerns of the public about the initial fluctuations in the amount of collected and paid funds after independent operation, Zheng Kaiyin, General Manager of One Card, pointed out that the previous highest monthly transaction amount was around NT$41 billion when cooperating with LINE Pay, although there was an adjustment period after separation, the performance has quickly rebounded within half a year.

According to the latest statistics, the number of One Card electronic payment users has reached 7,253,660 in July, and in terms of transaction amounts (collected and paid), it has increased significantly from approximately NT$18.3 billion in June to approximately NT$23.7 billion in July, with a single-month increase of nearly NT$5.4 billion, recovering to more than half of the previous peak, demonstrating extremely strong resilience.

items.title: 股市震盪照賺！公股4金2銀前7月獲利1057億破紀錄 銀保證「金雞母」同步發威
paras: 台股 7 月一度歷經劇烈震盪，成交量明顯萎縮，不少券商與金融機構面臨市場波動考驗，但公股金融體系仍展現強韌獲利能力。公股四金二銀包括兆豐金、第一金、華南金、合庫金，以及彰銀、臺企銀，累計前7月合計稅後純益達1,057.35億元，較去年同期大幅成長23.7%，寫下亮眼成績。其中兆豐金穩居獲利王寶座，第一金與華南金雙雙突破200億元大關，形成公股金融「200億俱樂部」三強鼎立局面。
從獲利排名來看，兆豐金以前7月稅後純益256.59億元居冠，每股稅後純益（EPS）達1.73元；第一金累計獲利209.37億元、年增23.6%，華南金則以206.52億元緊追在後，三家金控成為今年公股金融獲利表現最亮眼的領頭羊。

兆豐金續坐獲利王 銀行本業穩健撐盤

身為公股金控獲利龍頭，兆豐金主要成長動能仍來自兆豐銀行。兆豐銀行7月受惠財富管理業務擴張、放款規模成長，以及約15億元股利收入挹注，推升利息淨收益與手續費收入同步增加。
雖然受到美元波動影響，換匯交易收益較去年同期減少，拖累部分財務操作表現，但整體銀行獲利仍維持高檔。至於旗下兆豐證券雖因7月台股拉回、成交量降溫而出現單月虧損，但累計前7月獲利仍較去年同期大增約1.7倍，續創同期新高。
此外，兆豐票券受惠債券投資部位增加及利差擴大，兆豐產險則因防疫險理賠效應逐漸淡化，加上意外險保費收入與股利收益成長，前7月獲利年增幅皆超過4成，展現非銀行子公司的獲利支撐力道。

第一金衝破200億元 一銀單月獲利創歷史紀錄

第一金今年正式躋身公股金控獲利前段班，前7月稅後純益達209.37億元，創下歷年同期新高。
最大獲利引擎仍是旗下第一銀行。受惠股利收入入帳及金融交易收益成長，第一銀行7月單月稅後純益衝上32.02億元，創下歷史單月新高紀錄；累計前7月獲利186.58億元，年增12.7%。
資產品質方面亦維持優異表現，截至7月底逾放比降至0.16%，覆蓋率大幅提升至876.8%，顯示風險控管能力持續增強。
除了銀行本業穩健成長外，第一金證券更成為今年集團最大驚喜。雖然7月受到股市回檔影響，經紀手續費及投資收益下滑，但累計前7月稅後純益達15.31億元，較去年同期暴增262.9%，不僅提前超越去年全年獲利，更改寫歷史紀錄。第一金人壽累計獲利5.93億元，也較去年同期大幅成長，成為金控獲利另一支柱。

華南金刷新紀錄 非銀行獲利占比提升

華南金今年同樣繳出亮眼成績單。前7月稅後純益206.52億元，不僅創下歷年同期新高，包括華南銀行、華南永昌證券、華南產險及華南創投在內的主要子公司獲利也同步刷新紀錄。
其中華南銀行仍是集團核心獲利來源，累計前7月賺進162億元、年增15%，占整體金控獲利比重約76%。在存放款規模持續擴大、財富管理收入年增33%、加上金融操作收益提升帶動下，銀行獲利穩定成長。
值得注意的是，華南金近年積極提升非銀行事業比重，今年成果逐漸顯現。非銀行子公司獲利占比已提升至24%，其中華南永昌證券累計獲利35.31億元、年增285%；華南產險則賺進13.21億元，年增38%，受惠商業火險與工程險業務成長，以及損失率改善帶動核保利益提升。

合庫金、彰銀續創高 臺企銀單月成長最強

合庫金前7月稅後純益160.77億元，年增33.2%，續創同期新高。旗下合庫銀行、合庫證券與合庫人壽同步刷新歷史紀錄。
其中合庫銀行累計獲利142.55億元、年增12.55%；合庫證券累計獲利13.61億元，較去年同期大幅增加13.33億元；合庫人壽則受惠投資收益改善，前7月獲利11.28億元，年增約4.4倍，成長幅度驚人。
彰銀方面，則在利息淨收益及手續費收入同步成長帶動下，前7月稅後盈餘達134.92億元，年增22.34%，續創歷年同期新高。彰銀指出，財富管理業務已占整體手續費收入近八成，高資產客戶經營、信託服務與退休理財需求持續成長，成為推升獲利的重要引擎。
至於臺企銀則是六家公股金融機構中7月表現最亮眼者。7月單月稅後純益15.06億元，年增20.1%，年增幅居六家之冠；累計前7月獲利89.18億元，年增16.29%。
臺企銀表示，獲利成長主要受惠企金放款規模擴大、利息收入穩定增加，以及財富管理與海外業務收益同步成長。此外，近年積極拓展中小企業授信及海外據點效益逐步發酵，加上資產品質穩健，推升整體獲利表現。
法人認為，在利率仍維持相對高檔、銀行利差收益穩定，以及財富管理與保險投資收益回升帶動下，公股金融體系今年獲利動能可望延續。即便7月台股出現劇烈震盪，公股四金二銀仍能繳出逾千億元獲利成績，也凸顯其兼具穩定收益與抗波動能力，在金融股中持續扮演獲利基本盤角色。

items.title: 外資本周天天買超共2061億元  最青睞力積電連4天加碼逾31萬張
items.title_en: Foreign Capital Buys NT$206.1 Billion in a Week, Favoring Powerchip
paras: 台股今(14)日開高走低，下跌210點作收，終場收45,811點，成交金額略微放大至1.06兆元。外資單日買超453億元，累計本周 5個交易連續買超5日買超達2,061億元，其中看好記憶體回溫、代工價格調漲，單日加碼力積電(6770-TW) 14.49萬張居完 ，連 4買超共31.63萬張。
三大法人操作部分，外資單日買超453.51億元、投信買超71.96億元、自營商賣超16.61億元，三大法人合計共買超508.86億元。期貨部位，外資期貨空單減少1,034口，累計為8.51萬口。

今日外資單日買超前10名中，外資買超力積電14.49萬張居冠，其次買進主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)9.52萬張、主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)5.86萬張、華邦電5.58萬張、仁寶4.78萬張、群創3.96萬張、元大台灣50(0050-TW)3.58萬張、主動復華未來50(00991A-TW)2.77萬張、主動凱基台灣(00407A)2.7萬張、寶成2.11萬張。外資今日也調節台積電由連5買轉賣3,024張。
外資單日賣超前10名中，賣超國巨*2.22萬張居冠、其次賣超中鋼1.89萬張，也大賣金融股玉山金1.73萬張、臺企銀1.64萬張、華航1.63萬張、長榮航1.61萬張、國泰永續高股息(00878-TW)1.48萬張、元大台灣50反1(00632R-TW)1.12萬張、南亞科1萬張、元大金9,277張。
投信單日買超前10名中共9名皆為金融股，台新新光金、凱基金同為2.5萬張最多、玉山金1.83萬張、兆豐金1.55萬張、第一金1.46萬張、永豐金1.44萬張、華南金1.16萬張、元大金5,100張、華邦電3,770張、富邦特選高股息30(00900-TW)2,500張。
投信單日賣超前10名，則以電子權值股為主，大賣聯電5,627張、大成鋼5,000    張、日月光投控3,770張、緯創2,862張、鴻海2,552張、昇陽半導體1,544    張、南亞1,491張，賣景碩、勤誠、華通。
法人表示，台股今日呈現開高走低格局，指數正挑戰前波歷史高點壓力區，技術面上今日台股漲多拉回整理，目前在台股波動率走低態勢不變下，續作高檔整理，短線台股的拉回仍可以樂觀看待。籌碼布局上觀察，外資期現貨樂觀布局，整體籌碼面略為樂觀。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market opened high and closed low today, with the index falling 210 points to 45,811. The trading volume increased slightly to NT$1.06 trillion. Foreign investors bought a net NT$45.35 billion, making it the fifth consecutive day of net buying, with a total of NT$206.1 billion for the week. They were optimistic about the memory chip industry's rebound and the increase in foundry prices, and bought 144,900 shares of Powerchip (6770-TW) on the day, with a total of 316,300 shares over four days.

In terms of the operations of the three major institutional investors, foreign investors bought a net NT$45.35 billion, while investment trusts bought a net NT$7.2 billion, and dealers sold a net NT$1.66 billion. The total net buying of the three major institutional investors was NT$50.89 billion. In the futures market, foreign investors reduced their short positions by 1,034 contracts, with a total of 85,100 contracts.

Among the top 10 stocks with the largest net buying by foreign investors, Powerchip ranked first with 144,900 shares, followed by Fubon TWSE Taiwan 50 (00981A-TW) with 95,200 shares, Fubon Taiwan 50 (00403A-TW) with 58,600 shares, and other stocks. Foreign investors also adjusted their holdings of TSMC, selling 3,024 shares.

Among the top 10 stocks with the largest net selling by foreign investors, China Steel ranked first with 22,200 shares, followed by other stocks such as Yuanta Financial and EVA Airways. Foreign investors also sold a significant number of shares in the financial sector.

Among the top 10 stocks with the largest net buying by investment trusts, all were in the financial sector, with Taiwan Shin Kong Financial and Cathay Financial both buying 25,000 shares, followed by other stocks such as Yuanta Financial and Mega Financial.

Among the top 10 stocks with the largest net selling by investment trusts, most were in the electronics sector, with United Microelectronics selling 5,627 shares, followed by other stocks such as AU Optronics and Pegatron.

Institutional investors said that the Taiwan stock market presented a pattern of opening high and closing low today, with the index challenging the historical high point pressure zone. From a technical perspective, the market is still in a state of low volatility, and the current high-level adjustment is expected to continue. The layout of the chips is still optimistic, and the overall chip layout is slightly optimistic.

items.title: Fed暫時不用升息了？通膨降溫讓華許找到觀望理由
items.title_en: Fed May Not Need to Raise Rates Yet? Cooling Inflation Gives Warsh Reason to Hold Back
paras: 美國7月消費者與生產者物價增幅低於預期，加上就業市場降溫，正削弱聯準會(Fed)短期內升息的理由。儘管通膨仍明顯高於2%目標，且決策官員對物價風險看法分歧，近期數據可能促使5月上任的主席華許(Kevin Warsh)帶領Fed維持利率不變，延長按兵不動的時間。
華許接掌Fed時，貨幣政策正處於十字路口。部分官員主張升息以控制通膨，總統川普則不斷要求降息刺激經濟。然而，目前經濟既未明顯朝失業率上升發展，通膨也未重新加速，使Fed缺乏立即採取行動的迫切理由。

通膨降溫讓Fed更有理由等待

美國勞動市場並未蓬勃成長，過去6個月經通膨調整後的實質薪資下降，就業成長也相當疲弱，但失業率仍維持在歷史低檔的4.1%。另一方面，今年初美國與以色列對伊朗的戰爭曾推升能源價格，帶動通膨急遽升高，但過去兩個月物價壓力已逐漸緩和。
Fed偏好的個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數在連續3個月受到戰爭推升能源價格影響後，5月升至4.1%，6月則回落至3.7%。雖然仍遠高於Fed的2%目標，但下降趨勢已削弱「不升息就無法壓低通膨」的論點。
最新數據進一步支持觀望立場。美國7月生產者物價指數(PPI)按月意外持平，消費者物價指數(CPI)也僅微幅上升，且6月曾出現下滑。近期就業意外減少，加上CPI與PPI均低於預期，促使交易員大幅撤回對Fed在9月15日至16日會議升息的押注。
里奇蒙Fed總裁巴金(Thomas Barkin)表示，許多官員認為目前利率水準仍具足夠限制性，可繼續推動通膨下降。近期物價加速很大程度來自關稅提高、油價上漲及人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮等衝擊，而這些因素最終都可能消退。
巴金也指出，媒體、金融市場及民眾將注意力集中在近期通膨降溫，有助於穩定物價預期。只要市場持續接收到「通膨正在下降」的訊息，即使通膨已超過Fed目標逾5年，也可能降低立即升息的必要性。

鷹派憂心高通膨逐漸根深蒂固

不過，部分官員擔心，通膨長時間高於2%可能推升消費者與企業的物價預期，最後形成自我實現的循環。當企業預期未來成本還會上升，便可能提前漲價；消費者若認定高通膨將持續，也可能改變薪資要求與支出行為，使物價壓力更加難以消除。
Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)與庫克(Lisa Cook)近期均表示，若通膨未能迅速降溫，他們將支持升息。克里夫蘭Fed總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)更質疑，若Fed還需要3至4年才能將通膨降至2%，這樣的速度是否可以接受。
哈瑪克是上月反對Fed維持利率在3.50%至3.75%的3名決策官員之一，她主張立即升息。另有兩名今年不具投票權的地區Fed總裁隨後也表示支持升息。
哈瑪克引述辛辛那提一家零售商的說法指出，業者正提前調高售價，因為即使不知道下一波成本壓力來自何處，也相信漲價壓力終將出現。她認為，Fed應立即採取行動，以比目前緩慢下降的路徑更快將通膨拉回2%。
SGH Macro Advisors首席美國經濟學家Tim Duy警告，通膨停留在目前水準愈久，愈可能固化於民眾預期之中。一旦市場不再相信2%目標，Fed日後就必須付出更高代價，採取更強力措施才能重新建立公信力。

升息與不升息各有代價

華許至今未透露下一步政策計畫，也避免提供任何明確前瞻指引。川普則持續要求大幅降息，並指責華許在Fed內部的「敵意」同僚阻擋降息。不過，目前幾乎沒有數據顯示經濟疲弱到需要採取川普期望的降息措施。
Fed面臨的難題是，升息可能透過提高借貸成本壓低經濟活動，甚至推升失業率，而通膨本身可能已在逐步下降；但若持續按兵不動，也可能讓民眾逐漸失去對2%目標的信心。
Fed官員將在9月會議後公布最新經濟與利率預測。截至6月中旬，多數官員預估，PCE通膨將在2027年底降至2.2%至2.5%；但華許的同僚中，只有一半認為今年底前至少需要升息1碼，其餘官員除1人外均認為利率應維持不變，凸顯決策陣營的高度分歧。
Natixis首席美國經濟學家Christopher Hodge表示，未來幾次Fed會議都存在意外升息的可能，但隨通膨緩慢朝目標下降、消費部門降溫，以及就業前景轉趨脆弱，Fed最終應能勉強避免升息。這意味華許領導下的Fed可能既不升息，也不順應川普要求降息，而是在兩種風險之間維持更長時間的觀望。
paras_en: U.S. July consumer and producer price increases came in below expectations, and a cooling labor market is eroding the short‑term case for another Fed rate hike. Even though inflation remains well above the 2% target and policymakers are split on price risks, the latest data could prompt the Fed, led by Chairman Kevin Warsh who took office in May, to keep rates steady and extend the pause.

When Warsh assumed the Fed’s helm, monetary policy was at a crossroads. Some officials advocated raising rates to curb inflation, while President Trump repeatedly called for cuts to spur growth. Yet the economy is not showing a clear rise in unemployment and inflation has not re‑accelerated, leaving the Fed without an urgent trigger to act now.

Cooling inflation gives the Fed more reason to wait. The U.S. labor market is not booming; real wages adjusted for inflation have fallen over the past six months and job growth is weak, though the unemployment rate remains at a historically low 4.1%. Earlier this year, the U.S.–Israel conflict with Iran pushed energy prices higher and spiked inflation, but price pressures have eased over the past two months.

The Fed‑preferred personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index, after three months of war‑driven energy price spikes, rose to 4.1% in May and fell back to 3.7% in June. While still far above the Fed’s 2% goal, the downward trend weakens the argument that “no rate hike means inflation cannot be lowered.”

The latest data further support a wait‑and‑see stance. July’s producer price index (PPI) was unexpectedly flat month‑over‑month, and the consumer price index (CPI) rose only modestly, after a dip in June. Recent weaker‑than‑expected job numbers, combined with CPI and PPI below forecasts, have led traders to pull back bets on a rate hike at the September 15‑16 meeting.

Richmond Fed President Thomas Barkin said many officials believe the current rate level remains sufficiently restrictive to keep inflation falling. Recent price accelerations stem largely from higher tariffs, rising oil prices and an AI investment boom, all of which may eventually recede.

Barkin also noted that media, markets and the public focusing on the recent cooling of inflation helps anchor price expectations. As long as the market continues to receive the message that “inflation is easing,” even though inflation has been above the Fed’s target for more than five years, the urgency for an immediate hike could diminish.

Hawkish officials worry that persistently high inflation could embed higher price expectations among consumers and firms, creating a self‑fulfilling cycle. If firms expect future cost increases, they may raise prices early; if consumers believe high inflation will continue, they may demand higher wages and alter spending, making price pressures harder to eliminate.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller and Lisa Cook recently said they would back a hike if inflation does not cool quickly. Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack went further, questioning whether a three‑ to four‑year timeline to bring inflation down to 2% would be acceptable.

Hammack was one of three voting Fed officials last month who opposed keeping the policy rate in the 3.50%‑3.75% range and advocated an immediate hike. Two other regional Fed presidents without voting rights later also voiced support for a rate increase this year.

Citing a Cincinnati retailer, Hammack said firms are pre‑emptively raising prices because, even if they don’t know the next source of cost pressure, they expect price hikes to come. She argues the Fed should act now to pull inflation back to 2% faster than the current gradual decline.

Tim Duy, chief U.S. economist at SGH Macro Advisors, warned that the longer inflation stays at current levels, the more it can become entrenched in public expectations. If markets stop believing the 2% target is achievable, the Fed will later have to pay a higher price and take stronger measures to restore credibility.

Warsh has not disclosed his next policy move and has avoided giving clear forward guidance. Trump continues to demand large cuts and blames “hostile” colleagues inside the Fed for blocking rate cuts. Yet there is little data suggesting the economy is weak enough to warrant the deep cuts Trump wants.

The Fed’s dilemma is that raising rates could dampen economic activity and lift unemployment while inflation may already be on a downward path; but staying put for too long could erode public confidence in the 2% goal.

Fed officials will release updated economic and rate forecasts after the September meeting. As of mid‑June, most projected PCE inflation to fall to 2.2%‑2.5% by the end of 2027, but only half of Warsh’s colleagues think at least one more 25‑basis‑point hike is needed before year‑end, while the rest, except one, see rates staying unchanged, highlighting deep division.

Christopher Hodge, chief U.S. economist at Natixis, said unexpected hikes remain possible at upcoming Fed meetings, but with inflation slowly edging toward target, consumer demand cooling and a fragile employment outlook, the Fed should ultimately be able to avoid further hikes. This suggests that under Warsh’s leadership the Fed may neither raise rates nor cut them at Trump’s urging, opting instead for an extended period of observation between the two risks.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉零售銷售降溫削弱Fed升息預期！主要指數漲跌互現
paras: 美股主要指數周五(14日)開盤走勢分歧，標普500指數在前一交易日創下收盤新高後變動不大，有望連續第三周收紅。美國7月零售銷售意外下滑，進一步削弱市場對聯準會(Fed)9月升息的押注，但投資人仍密切評估中東局勢與能源價格上漲風險。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近30點或近0.1%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近20點或0.06%，標普 500 指數漲0.02%，費城半導體指數跌近0.6%。台積電 ADR 跌近0.8%。
美股周五盤前維持在歷史高點附近，人工智慧(AI)交易熱度回升，加上最新經濟數據促使市場下調聯準會(Fed)升息預期，支撐風險資產買氣。不過，伊朗局勢與荷姆茲海峽航運風險仍可能推高能源價格，為通膨與市場前景增添變數。
截稿前，標普500指數期貨上漲0.1%，該指數周四甫創下收盤新高；那斯達克100指數期貨上漲0.3%，本周漲幅可望達到1.2%。記憶體業者Sandisk(SNDK-US)獲摩根大通調升評等後，盤前上漲近6%，投資人同時關注OpenAI赴華爾街上市的相關計畫。

AI資金重新湧入科技硬體

科技股本月推動標普500指數屢創新高，投資人重新布局先前遭到拋售的半導體與其他AI概念股。相關企業第二季財報普遍優於市場原本已相當樂觀的預期，使投資焦點重新回到實際營收與獲利成長。
美國銀行(BofA)由Michael Hartnett領軍的策略師團隊表示，市場多頭進一步推升風險資產的「大門已經敞開」，主要支撐因素包括企業獲利飆升、2026年家庭財富增加10兆美元，以及2027年AI資本支出預計超過1兆美元。
被視為AI投資風向球的南韓綜合股價指數(Kospi)周五上漲逾2%，本周累計大漲11%，終止連續7周下跌。三星電子與SK海力士過去5個交易日均上漲逾15%，反映資金重新追捧AI硬體與記憶體類股。
Asset Management One首席策略師Hitoshi Asaoka表示，大量超大規模雲端服務商資金正流入硬體領域，並轉化為硬體公司的強勁營收與獲利成長。投資人因而重新將注意力放在企業基本面，而非只關注AI投資規模與估值疑慮。
貨幣政策預期也為股市提供支撐。美國7月零售銷售創逾一年最大降幅，加上本周公布的消費者與生產者物價數據均較溫和，強化Fed保持耐心的理由。對政策前景敏感的2年期美債殖利率下跌4個基點至4.11%，美元指數則下跌0.4%。

能源與長債殖利率仍藏風險

儘管市場風險偏好回升，能源價格再度推升通膨的威脅並未消失。布蘭特原油周五一度大漲近2%，其後回吐漲幅，降至每桶約87美元。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)表示，美方將對伊朗實施前所未有的「經濟孤立」，並配合持續封鎖伊朗港口，形成雙重打擊。
Plurimi Wealth投資長Patrick Armstrong警告，荷姆茲海峽短期內恐怕無法完全恢復正常運輸，市場對相關風險可能過於自滿。一旦原油供應再受干擾，能源價格上漲可能重新推升通膨，並迫使投資人重新評估Fed政策路徑。
美國周四標售30年期公債的得標殖利率升至25年來最高，也凸顯投資人要求更高的風險溢價，才願意為美國龐大財政赤字提供融資。長天期殖利率居高不下，可能對股票估值構成壓力。
《彭博》策略師Skylar Montgomery Koning指出，市場展現出驚人韌性，夏季行情可能以樂觀氣氛收尾，但表面平靜之下的尾部風險正持續擴大，尤其集中於大宗商品價格上漲、停滯性通膨及長天期債券殖利率攀升。

items.title: 美國7月零售銷售意外下滑0.6% 創逾一年最大跌幅
paras: 美國7月零售銷售意外下滑，月減0.6%，創2025年5月以來最大降幅，遠遜市場預期的月增0.1%，顯示消費者在上半年強勁支出後暫時踩下煞車。除了大筆退稅帶來的一次性刺激逐漸消退，亞馬遜(Amazon)(AMZN-US)將Prime Day促銷活動提前至6月，以及世界盃賽事帶來的消費熱潮降溫，也共同拖累7月數據。
美國商務部人口普查局周五(14日)公布，7月零售銷售月減0.6%，6月則維持月增0.2%不變。零售銷售主要反映商品消費，且未經通膨調整；按年計算，7月銷售額仍成長5%，整體消費尚未陷入全面衰退。

Prime Day提前透支消費動能

13個零售類別中有5類銷售下滑，其中包括亞馬遜在內的非實體店面零售商銷售重挫2.2%，成為整體數據的最大拖累之一。美國銀行(BofA)指出，由於亞馬遜今年將Prime Day由7月提前至6月，其他零售商也同步推出競爭性促銷，使原本應在7月發生的網路購物需求被提前釋放。
汽車及零件經銷商銷售也下滑1.8%，與車廠公布的銷售量減少一致。加油站收入則因汽油價格回落而下降，服飾與家具等類別同樣走弱。分析認為，7月初的熱浪與世界盃結束後的消費降溫，也可能對當月支出造成一定影響。
不過，餐廳和酒吧收入逆勢成長0.5%，顯示服務消費仍具韌性。若排除汽車與汽油，7月零售銷售下滑0.2%。
更值得注意的是，排除餐飲、汽車、建材與加油站的核心零售銷售，也就是最接近國內生產毛額(GDP)商品消費計算的「控制組銷售」，7月下滑0.4%，創2025年初以來最大降幅，明顯不如市場預期的成長0.3%。6月增幅也由原先公布的0.5%下修至0.4%。

退稅紅利消退但財富效應仍在

美國消費者今年稍早獲得較為可觀的退稅，抵銷中東衝突推升汽油價格帶來的衝擊，並支撐第二季消費支出以年率3.2%成長，帶動同期經濟成長1.5%。但經濟學家指出，這項一次性紅利如今大致用盡，加上6月個人儲蓄率降至四年低點，讓下半年消費展望面臨更多不確定性。
美國銀行與PNC Financial的刷卡數據也顯示，在Prime Day與世界盃帶動6月支出後，7月消費成長速度明顯放緩。PNC指出，家庭對汽油價格上漲似乎比年初更加敏感，使下半年消費環境變得較不有利。
不過，多數經濟學家認為7月疲軟可能只是暫時現象。標普500指數今年已上漲14%，股市走高推升家庭財富，尤其愈來愈多高所得與年長家庭正將資產增值轉化為消費。美國銀行也指出，家庭儲蓄仍高於疫情前水準，而且全額繳清信用卡帳單的家庭比率持續增加。
刷卡資料還顯示，過去幾周低所得家庭的消費成長反而高於高所得家庭，即使排除汽油支出也是如此，意味過去高所得者支撐消費、低所得者承壓的「K型經濟」格局可能正在淡化。儘管退稅紅利消退與價格敏感度升高構成風險，但在股市財富效應和家庭財務狀況支撐下，經濟學家仍難以想像美國消費會真正失速。

items.title: 從蘋果到福特都繞不開！中國科技正深入全球企業供應鏈
paras: 儘管華盛頓持續加強對中國科技業的限制，從人工智慧(AI)、電動車到電池供應鏈，中國技術卻日益深入全球大型企業的營運。
蘋果(Apple)(AAPL-US)在中國市場借助阿里巴巴與百度(BIDU-US)(09888-HK)發展AI服務，福特(Ford)(F-US)引進寧德時代(CATL)電池技術；福斯汽車(Volkswagen)則與小鵬汽車(XPEV-US)(09868-HK)合作開發智慧電動車，Stellantis(STLA-US)也擴大與零跑汽車在生產及聯合採購方面的合作。
分析師指出，一場更廣泛的結構性轉變正在發生。中國過去主要是跨國企業銷售商品的市場，如今在部分產業已成為技術、供應鏈能力與創新的來源，全球企業愈來愈難繞開。

中國從銷售市場轉為技術來源

IDC中國區董事總經理Kitty Fok表示，5年前全球企業主要前往中國銷售產品，如今在某些領域，企業前往中國是為了取得技術能力。這項轉變正值美國持續遏制中國科技發展之際。華為2019年遭列入黑名單後，美國陸續限制先進晶片及製造設備出口，並管制對中國半導體、量子科技和AI領域的部分投資，包括中芯國際(SMIC)在內的企業也受到制裁。
然而，中國已在多個科技產業建立難以忽視的地位。Counterpoint Research數據顯示，比亞迪、長安汽車和奇瑞等中國車廠，2025年合計占全球電動車市場近63%；寧德時代、比亞迪、中創新航和國軒高科等電池製造商，市占率更接近70%。
Counterpoint首席分析師Soumen Mandal指出，成本、規模、製造能力、供應鏈整合及創新速度，都是全球企業持續與中國公司合作的重要原因。中國的科技優勢已不再只是低成本製造，而是進一步延伸至龐大產能、完整供應鏈及產品快速迭代，迫使跨國企業在地緣政治風險與商業現實之間尋求平衡。
這項轉變在電動車電池領域尤其明顯。福特正利用寧德時代的磷酸鐵鋰電池技術，在密西根州興建規模35億美元的電池廠。Fok表示，供應商更換不是一季內就能完成的採購決策，還須經過多年工程設計、測試與重新認證，因此中國電池技術一旦嵌入全球供應鏈便很難抽離。
部分合作則主要是為了在中國市場維持競爭力。由於外國供應商受到限制，在中國營運且需要AI或雲端基礎設施的跨國企業，通常必須採用當地服務，蘋果與阿里巴巴、百度合作便是其中一例。Omdia首席分析師Lian Jye Su指出，進入中國市場仍是許多合作案的主要動力，但電池、電動車、儲能及應用型AI領域也正出現緩慢而持續的供應鏈與創新重組。

AI成為下一個競爭前線

中國技術的影響力也開始向AI擴散。IDC今年稍早調查歐洲企業發現，廣泛採用中國AI模型的兩大原因，分別是安全及法規遵循要求，以及更優異的性能，成本反而不是首要考量。Fok認為，西方企業採用中國AI並非單純因為價格較低，而是由模型表現驅動，再以安全與合規條件把關。
有別於美國的Anthropic與OpenAI，阿里巴巴(BABA-US)(09988-HK)、DeepSeek等中國企業較積極發展開放原始碼模型，使全球開發者更容易取得及部署。Su表示，美國限制雖壓縮中國取得尖端半導體的能力，卻也成為推動中國本土創新與效率提升的催化劑，使中國供應商在AI、電池及汽車軟體方面仍具競爭力。
不過，中國技術並非會在所有領域暢行無阻。先進半導體、網路安全、國防及涉及國家安全的服務，預料仍將面臨最強烈阻力。分析師認為，未來不會是全面封殺或全面接受，而是依產業採取不同立場。中國技術可望持續擴展至電動車、電池、消費電子、機器人、無人機，以及部分AI與半導體領域，形成更分裂、但也更務實的全球科技生態。

items.title: 華爾街沒人喊賣了！波音苦熬多年終於迎來翻身時刻
items.title_en: Wall Street's Confidence in Boeing's Recovery Grows
paras: 華爾街對波音(Boeing)(BA-US)復甦前景的信心明顯升溫，分析師給予買進評等的比率本周升至2022年10月以來最高。彭博追蹤的32名分析師中，目前沒有任何一人建議賣出波音股票，顯示市場看法正從過去的疑慮與觀望，逐步轉向正面。
Argus Research與法國巴黎銀行(BNP Paribas)在短短10天內接連調升波音評等，成為市場情緒轉折的重要訊號。Tigress Financial投資長暨研究主管Ivan Feinseth表示，歷經多年掙扎後，「現在是波音發光的時候」，並給予買進評等及華爾街最高的305美元目標價。

737 Max 7取證成復甦關鍵里程碑

分析師轉趨樂觀，正值波音上周取得美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)對737 Max 7的認證，結束近十年的漫長審查。這段過程曾受到兩起致命空難、飛機品質缺失等問題干擾，波音商用飛機部門執行長Stephanie Pope形容，取得認證是公司復甦過程中的「關鍵時刻」。
過去數年，波音先後遭遇737 Max空難、新冠疫情重創航空需求，以及飛行途中艙門塞脫落等危機，導致投資人不再輕易相信公司的復甦承諾，必須等待生產、交付與現金流改善的具體證據。
不過，這些證據已開始出現。波音上月公布強勁財報，自由現金流遠優於市場預期；Argus分析師Kristina Ruggeri也以產量可望顯著提升為由，將評等由持有調升至買進。Integrity Asset Management投資組合經理Joe Gilbert表示，市場一直等待波音證明自身執行能力，而相關成果如今已開始浮現。
法國巴黎銀行分析師Matthew Akers原本是市場唯一給予波音等同賣出評等的分析師，但他上周也轉變立場，認為波音在疫情後充滿不確定性的時期已經結束，並給出市場數一數二高的目標價。他預期，市場對波音自由現金流的估值先前下修過度，未來預測可望逐步回升，股價至2030年存在接近翻倍的空間。

飛機需求旺盛但估值仍待業績驗證

除了內部營運改善，波音與空中巴士(Airbus)共同主導全球大型商用飛機市場，也有望受惠於未來數年的飛機需求熱潮及各國國防支出增加。分析師預估，波音今年自由現金流約為24.4億美元，但仍遠低於2018年的136億美元；每股虧損估為0.83美元，相較2018年曾獲利16.01美元，顯示公司距離完全恢復仍有一段路。
波音股價今年迄今僅上漲約6%，落後大盤13%的漲幅，競爭對手空中巴士同期則上漲約8%。目前波音股價約為未來12個月預估營收的1.7倍，已高於過去十年平均的1.5倍，也意味著部分復甦預期可能已反映在估值中。
相較2019年3月創下的440.62美元歷史高點，波音股價至今仍下跌近50%；同期間，標普500指數上漲約180%、道瓊工業指數翻倍，空中巴士股價也上漲近90%。Wealth Alliance總裁Eric Diton表示，現在或許還太早稱波音進入「新時代」，但歷經多年困境後，公司今年轉向正面動能的跡象已清楚可見。
paras_en: Wall Street's confidence in Boeing's (BA-US) recovery prospects has increased, with the proportion of analysts giving a buy rating rising to its highest level since October 2022. None of the 32 analysts tracked by Bloomberg are recommending selling Boeing stock, indicating a shift in market sentiment from skepticism to positivity.

Argus Research and BNP Paribas have upgraded their ratings for Boeing within the past 10 days, marking a significant turning point in market sentiment. Ivan Feinseth, chief investment officer and research director at Tigress Financial, believes that after years of struggle, 'it's Boeing's time to shine' and has given the company a buy rating with a target price of $305, the highest on Wall Street.

The 737 Max 7's certification is a key milestone in Boeing's recovery. Analysts have become more optimistic after Boeing received certification from the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) for the 737 Max 7 last week, ending a decade-long review process that was disrupted by two fatal crashes and quality control issues. Stephanie Pope, head of Boeing's commercial airplanes division, described the certification as a 'key moment' in the company's recovery.

In recent years, Boeing has faced numerous challenges, including the 737 Max crashes, the COVID-19 pandemic, which severely impacted air travel demand, and issues with its aircraft, such as a loose cabin door. As a result, investors have been cautious about believing in the company's recovery promises, waiting for concrete evidence of improved production, delivery, and cash flow.

However, such evidence has started to emerge. Boeing reported strong earnings last month, with free cash flow far exceeding market expectations. Argus analyst Kristina Ruggeri upgraded her rating from hold to buy, citing the expected significant increase in production. Joe Gilbert, portfolio manager at Integrity Asset Management, stated that the market has been waiting for Boeing to demonstrate its execution capabilities, and the results are now starting to materialize.

BNP Paribas analyst Matthew Akers, who was the only analyst with a sell equivalent rating for Boeing, has changed his stance, believing that the company has ended its post-pandemic uncertainty period. He has given a high target price, predicting that the market's valuation of Boeing's free cash flow was overly reduced and is expected to gradually recover, with the stock price having nearly double the potential by 2030.

In addition to its internal operational improvements, Boeing, along with Airbus, dominates the global large commercial aircraft market and is likely to benefit from the upcoming aircraft demand boom and increased defense spending. Analysts estimate that Boeing's free cash flow will be around $2.44 billion this year, still far below the $13.6 billion in 2018, and the company is expected to report a loss per share of $0.83, compared to a profit of $16.01 in 2018, indicating that the company still has a long way to go to fully recover.

Boeing's stock price has only risen about 6% so far this year, underperforming the 13% gain in the broader market, while competitor Airbus has risen about 8%. Boeing's current stock price is approximately 1.7 times its estimated revenue over the next 12 months, higher than the 1.5 times average over the past decade, suggesting that some recovery expectations may already be reflected in the valuation.

Compared to its historical high of $440.62 in March 2019, Boeing's stock price has fallen nearly 50%. Over the same period, the S&P 500 has risen about 180%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average has doubled, and Airbus' stock price has risen nearly 90%. Eric Diton, president of Wealth Alliance, stated that it may be too early to say that Boeing has entered a 'new era,' but after years of struggles, the company's positive momentum this year is clearly visible.

items.title: 川普對無人機徵收100%關稅 料加深美中科技脫鉤
items.title_en: Trump Imposes 100% Tariff on Drones, Likely Deepening US-China Tech Decoupling
paras: 川普政府周四(13日)宣布，將對進口無人機及其零部件徵收最高達 100% 的關稅。此舉被視為美國減少對外國供應商依賴、保護本土產業的重大升級，並可能加速美中兩國在無人機供應鏈上的「脫鉤」進程。
根據白宮公告，這項關稅政策採取分級制：重量超過 25 公斤或具備特定性能的重型無人機將面臨 100% 的最高稅率；較小型的無人機則徵收 25% 的關稅。
為了鞏固與盟友的關係，美國對特定貿易夥伴提供了優惠：來自歐盟、日本、瑞士及台灣的無人機，若硬體與技術皆源自當地或美國，稅率將降至 15%，而英國則適用 10% 的稅率。多數關稅將在簽署後 21 天內生效，部分非敏感零部件則有 180 天的緩衝期。
此次決策是依據《1962年貿易擴張法》第 232 條，以國家安全為由發起調查後制定的。商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)指出，美國對外國無人機系統的依賴已達「實質性」程度，對國家安全構成風險。
川普在公告中強調，無人機系統對美國的國家與經濟安全至關重要。特別是俄烏戰爭充分展現了無人機在現代混合戰爭中的軍事效能，促使華府更具緊迫感地去扶持國內產業，避免在關鍵技術上受制於人。
雖然官方聲明未直接點名中國，但目標顯然直指全球最大的無人機製造國。在此之前，聯邦通訊委員會(FCC)已採取行動阻止大疆創新(DJI)等新機型進口，大疆去年曾占據美國 70% 的商用市場。專家分析，美中雙方正滑向特定類型無人機的「硬脫鉤」，這已成為兩國在基本貿易協定下持續進行低層級對抗的一部分。
受此政策激勵，美國本土無人機製造商如 AeroVironment 與 Aevex Corp 的股價在消息公布後大幅跳升。然而，中國方面也已展開反擊，對軍用無人機及關鍵技術實施「逐案審查」的出口管制。
paras_en: The Trump administration announced on Thursday (the 13th) that it will levy tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones and their components. The move is seen as a major upgrade in the United States’ effort to reduce reliance on foreign suppliers and protect domestic industry, and it could accelerate the “decoupling” of the US and China in the drone supply chain.

According to the White House announcement, the tariff policy uses a tiered system: heavy drones weighing more than 25 kilograms or possessing certain capabilities will face the maximum 100% rate, while smaller drones will be subject to a 25% tariff.

To strengthen ties with allies, the United States is offering preferential rates for specific trading partners: drones from the EU, Japan, Switzerland and Taiwan that are wholly sourced in hardware and technology from the local market or the United States will see the rate reduced to 15%, and the United Kingdom will receive a 10% rate. Most tariffs will take effect within 21 days of signing, with a 180‑day grace period for certain non‑sensitive components.

The decision is based on Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962, invoked on national‑security grounds after an investigation. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said U.S. reliance on foreign drone systems has reached a “substantial” level that poses a risk to national security.

In the announcement, Trump stressed that drone systems are critical to America’s national and economic security. The Russia‑Ukraine war has highlighted the military effectiveness of drones in modern hybrid warfare, giving Washington a heightened sense of urgency to support domestic producers and avoid dependence on critical technology.

Although the official statement did not name China directly, the target is clearly the world’s largest drone manufacturer. Previously, the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) moved to block new models from DJI and other firms; DJI accounted for about 70% of the U.S. commercial drone market last year. Experts say the U.S. and China are moving toward a “hard decoupling” of certain drone types, becoming part of a low‑level confrontation that persists despite broader trade agreements.

The policy spurred a sharp rise in the share prices of U.S. drone makers such as AeroVironment and Aevex Corp after the news broke. China, meanwhile, has begun retaliating with case‑by‑case export controls on military drones and key technologies.

items.title: 應用材料Q4展望優於預期仍跌5%市場憂成長落後同業
items.title_en: Applied Materials Q4 Outlook Better Than Expected, Still Drops 5% as Market Worries About Growth Lag
paras: 2026年08月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 應用材料Applied Materials(AMAT-US)週五盤前股價下跌約5%，儘管公司公布優於市場預期的2026會計年度第4季財測，但在股價今年已上漲約1倍後，投資人對成長要求提高，加上半導體設備市場競爭加劇，亮眼財測仍未能消除市場疑慮。
應用材料預估會計年度第4季營收約102.5億美元，高於市場預估的95.4億美元，毛利率預估維持在50.4%。不過，市場更關注公司能否在晶圓廠設備市場取得高於同業的成長，尤其科林研發Lam Research(LRCX-US)與科磊KLA(KLAC-US)先前均繳出強勁業績，艾司摩爾ASML(ASML-US)也已上調2026年展望。
市場分析認為，應用材料近期營收成長速度落後部分主要競爭對手，使投資人即使面對優於預期的財測，仍對後續市占率與成長動能保持謹慎。
估值方面，應用材料預估本益比約32.14倍，低於Lam Research的34.59倍、KLA的36.85倍及ASML的33.39倍。半導體設備股估值普遍處於較高水準，也意味市場對成長放緩的容忍度降低，財測優於預期已不足以單獨推升股價。

paras_en: On August 14, 2026, Applied Materials (AMAT-US) saw its stock price drop by about 5% before the market opened, despite the company releasing a better-than-expected forecast for the fourth quarter of the 2026 fiscal year. This drop occurred after the stock had already risen by about 100% this year, with investors now having higher growth expectations, coupled with increased competition in the semiconductor equipment market, making the promising forecast insufficient to alleviate market concerns.

Applied Materials estimates its fourth-quarter revenue to be around $10.25 billion, higher than the market's estimate of $9.54 billion, with a gross margin rate expected to remain at 50.4%. However, the market is more focused on whether the company can achieve growth higher than its peers in the wafer fabrication equipment market, especially after Lam Research (LRCX-US) and KLA (KLAC-US) reported strong performances, and ASML (ASML-US) has already raised its 2026 outlook.

Market analysts believe that Applied Materials' recent revenue growth rate has lagged behind some of its major competitors, making investors cautious about the company's future market share and growth momentum, even when faced with better-than-expected forecasts.

In terms of valuation, Applied Materials' estimated price-to-earnings ratio is around 32.14 times, lower than Lam Research's 34.59 times, KLA's 36.85 times, and ASML's 33.39 times. The high valuation of semiconductor equipment stocks also means that the market has a lower tolerance for growth slowdowns, and a better-than-expected forecast is no longer enough to single-handedly boost the stock price.

items.title: 頂尖研究員余家輝宣布離開 Meta祭高薪挖角卻仍難留住人才
items.title_en: Top Researcher Jiahui Yu Leaves Meta for Higher Pay, Still Struggles to Retain Talent
paras: Meta 超級智能實驗室(Meta Superintelligence Labs, MSL)核心成員、多模態研究負責人余家輝(Jiahui Yu)周五(14日)正式宣布離職，並計畫創辦新公司。
余家輝自 2025 年 6 月加入 Meta 以來，帶領團隊推出了 Muse 系列原生多模態模型，是 Meta 近年來在生成式人工智慧(Generative AI)領域的重要戰力。

從學霸到頂尖工程師

余家輝的學術與職業生涯始終環繞著「多模態」技術。他出身於中國科學技術大學少年班，隨後取得伊利諾大學厄巴納－香檳分校(UIUC)博士學位，師從知名電腦視覺學者黃煦濤。
在進入 Meta 之前，他已是 AI 界公認的頂尖人才，曾參與 Google 的 Gemini 專案，並擔任 OpenAI 感知(Perception)團隊負責人，主導 GPT-4o 及 o 系列推理模型的研發。
加入 Meta 後，余家輝擔任超級智能實驗室旗下 TBD Lab 的多模態技術負責人。他在離職公告中表示，過去一年在 Meta 與執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)及首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang 共同建設 TBD Lab 的經歷
「極具啟發且充實」。

Muse 系列產品線完備

在余家輝任職的 14 個月內，TBD Lab 完成了密集的產品發布。從 2026 年 4 月推出的基礎模型 Muse Spark 開始，標誌著 Meta 的前沿模型研發重心從 Llama 系列轉向更具備多模態能力的 Muse 系列。隨後，團隊接連推出 Voice Mode、Muse Image 與 Muse Video，全面覆蓋語音、影像與影片生成領域。
就在他宣布辭職前八天，Meta 才剛發布 Muse Spark 1.2，進一步強化了智慧代理人(Agent)能力與長程任務執行潛力。

九位數年薪爭議

關於余家輝的待遇，市場曾盛傳 Meta 以高達「1 億美元年薪」的創紀錄條件將他從 OpenAI 挖角。儘管 Meta 並未證實確切數字，但 CTO Andrew Bosworth曾針對市場傳言澄清，所謂的高額報酬並非一次性領取的簽約獎金，而是包含股票、獎金與績效條件的四年期總酬勞方案。
針對這種重金挖角的現象，OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 曾評論認為：「傳教士最終會擊敗僱傭兵(Missionaries will eventually beat the mercenaries)」。
隨著余家輝在短期內完成階段性任務後離職創業，科技作者 Gergely Orosz 指出，Meta 內部的組織重組與效率調整導致工程師產生不安感，許多資深專家開始對外部機會保持開放態度。

Meta 面臨人才流失挑戰

關於創業動向，余家輝並未透露新公司的細節，僅表示一個「對人類未來極其重要，但目前尚未被充分探索的問題」正吸引著他全部的注意力。
研究平台 alphaXiv 數據顯示，包含余家輝在內，Meta 已流失超過 200 名知名研究員，總計有 929 位研究人員處於「曾在 Meta 工作但已離職」的狀態。雖然 Meta 能夠透過短期高額報酬追趕技術差距，但如何修復組織信任並留住頂尖人才，仍是未來的重要挑戰。
paras_en: Meta's Superintelligence Labs core member and multimodal research lead Jiahui Yu announced his departure from the company on Friday, planning to start a new company.
Since joining Meta in June 2025, Yu has led his team to develop the Muse series of native multimodal models, which have been a crucial force in Meta's generative AI efforts in recent years.

From academic to top engineer, Yu's career has always revolved around 'multimodal' technology. He graduated from the Chinese Academy of Sciences' Youth Class and later earned a Ph.D. from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (UIUC), studying under renowned computer vision scholar Xutao Huang.

Before joining Meta, Yu was a recognized top talent in the AI field, having participated in Google's Gemini project and serving as the head of OpenAI's Perception team, leading the development of GPT-4o and o series reasoning models.

After joining Meta, Yu served as the multimodal technology lead at TBD Lab, a subsidiary of Superintelligence Labs. In his resignation announcement, he described his experience working with CEO Mark Zuckerberg and Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang to build TBD Lab as 'extremely inspiring and fulfilling'.

During his 14-month tenure, TBD Lab completed a series of product releases. Starting with the foundation model Muse Spark in April 2026, which marked a shift in Meta's cutting-edge model development focus from the Llama series to the more multimodal-capable Muse series, the team subsequently released Voice Mode, Muse Image, and Muse Video, covering speech, image, and video generation domains.
Just eight days before his resignation, Meta released Muse Spark 1.2, further enhancing the intelligent agent's capabilities and long-term task execution potential.
Nine-figure salary controversy

Regarding Yu's compensation, the market had previously reported that Meta offered him a record-breaking '1 billion US dollar annual salary' to poach him from OpenAI. Although Meta did not confirm the exact figure, CTO Andrew Bosworth clarified that the high-end compensation was not a one-time signing bonus but a four-year total compensation package including stock, bonuses, and performance-based conditions.
In response to this high-stakes poaching phenomenon, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman commented, 'Missionaries will eventually beat the mercenaries'.

As Yu completes his short-term tasks and leaves to start a new company, tech author Gergely Orosz pointed out that internal reorganization and efficiency adjustments within Meta have created anxiety among engineers, leading many senior experts to maintain an open attitude towards external opportunities.
Meta faces talent loss challenge

Regarding his entrepreneurial endeavors, Yu did not disclose details about his new company, stating that a 'problem extremely important for human future but currently underexplored' has captured his full attention.

items.title: Fed暫時不用升息了？通膨降溫讓華許找到觀望理由
items.title_en: Fed May Not Need to Raise Rates Yet? Cooling Inflation Gives Warsh Reason to Hold Back
paras: 美國7月消費者與生產者物價增幅低於預期，加上就業市場降溫，正削弱聯準會(Fed)短期內升息的理由。儘管通膨仍明顯高於2%目標，且決策官員對物價風險看法分歧，近期數據可能促使5月上任的主席華許(Kevin Warsh)帶領Fed維持利率不變，延長按兵不動的時間。
華許接掌Fed時，貨幣政策正處於十字路口。部分官員主張升息以控制通膨，總統川普則不斷要求降息刺激經濟。然而，目前經濟既未明顯朝失業率上升發展，通膨也未重新加速，使Fed缺乏立即採取行動的迫切理由。

通膨降溫讓Fed更有理由等待

美國勞動市場並未蓬勃成長，過去6個月經通膨調整後的實質薪資下降，就業成長也相當疲弱，但失業率仍維持在歷史低檔的4.1%。另一方面，今年初美國與以色列對伊朗的戰爭曾推升能源價格，帶動通膨急遽升高，但過去兩個月物價壓力已逐漸緩和。
Fed偏好的個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數在連續3個月受到戰爭推升能源價格影響後，5月升至4.1%，6月則回落至3.7%。雖然仍遠高於Fed的2%目標，但下降趨勢已削弱「不升息就無法壓低通膨」的論點。
最新數據進一步支持觀望立場。美國7月生產者物價指數(PPI)按月意外持平，消費者物價指數(CPI)也僅微幅上升，且6月曾出現下滑。近期就業意外減少，加上CPI與PPI均低於預期，促使交易員大幅撤回對Fed在9月15日至16日會議升息的押注。
里奇蒙Fed總裁巴金(Thomas Barkin)表示，許多官員認為目前利率水準仍具足夠限制性，可繼續推動通膨下降。近期物價加速很大程度來自關稅提高、油價上漲及人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮等衝擊，而這些因素最終都可能消退。
巴金也指出，媒體、金融市場及民眾將注意力集中在近期通膨降溫，有助於穩定物價預期。只要市場持續接收到「通膨正在下降」的訊息，即使通膨已超過Fed目標逾5年，也可能降低立即升息的必要性。

鷹派憂心高通膨逐漸根深蒂固

不過，部分官員擔心，通膨長時間高於2%可能推升消費者與企業的物價預期，最後形成自我實現的循環。當企業預期未來成本還會上升，便可能提前漲價；消費者若認定高通膨將持續，也可能改變薪資要求與支出行為，使物價壓力更加難以消除。
Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)與庫克(Lisa Cook)近期均表示，若通膨未能迅速降溫，他們將支持升息。克里夫蘭Fed總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)更質疑，若Fed還需要3至4年才能將通膨降至2%，這樣的速度是否可以接受。
哈瑪克是上月反對Fed維持利率在3.50%至3.75%的3名決策官員之一，她主張立即升息。另有兩名今年不具投票權的地區Fed總裁隨後也表示支持升息。
哈瑪克引述辛辛那提一家零售商的說法指出，業者正提前調高售價，因為即使不知道下一波成本壓力來自何處，也相信漲價壓力終將出現。她認為，Fed應立即採取行動，以比目前緩慢下降的路徑更快將通膨拉回2%。
SGH Macro Advisors首席美國經濟學家Tim Duy警告，通膨停留在目前水準愈久，愈可能固化於民眾預期之中。一旦市場不再相信2%目標，Fed日後就必須付出更高代價，採取更強力措施才能重新建立公信力。

升息與不升息各有代價

華許至今未透露下一步政策計畫，也避免提供任何明確前瞻指引。川普則持續要求大幅降息，並指責華許在Fed內部的「敵意」同僚阻擋降息。不過，目前幾乎沒有數據顯示經濟疲弱到需要採取川普期望的降息措施。
Fed面臨的難題是，升息可能透過提高借貸成本壓低經濟活動，甚至推升失業率，而通膨本身可能已在逐步下降；但若持續按兵不動，也可能讓民眾逐漸失去對2%目標的信心。
Fed官員將在9月會議後公布最新經濟與利率預測。截至6月中旬，多數官員預估，PCE通膨將在2027年底降至2.2%至2.5%；但華許的同僚中，只有一半認為今年底前至少需要升息1碼，其餘官員除1人外均認為利率應維持不變，凸顯決策陣營的高度分歧。
Natixis首席美國經濟學家Christopher Hodge表示，未來幾次Fed會議都存在意外升息的可能，但隨通膨緩慢朝目標下降、消費部門降溫，以及就業前景轉趨脆弱，Fed最終應能勉強避免升息。這意味華許領導下的Fed可能既不升息，也不順應川普要求降息，而是在兩種風險之間維持更長時間的觀望。
paras_en: U.S. July consumer and producer price increases came in below expectations, and a cooling labor market is eroding the short‑term case for another Fed rate hike. Even though inflation remains well above the 2% target and policymakers are split on price risks, the latest data could prompt the Fed, led by Chairman Kevin Warsh who took office in May, to keep rates steady and extend the pause.

When Warsh assumed the Fed’s helm, monetary policy was at a crossroads. Some officials advocated raising rates to curb inflation, while President Trump repeatedly called for cuts to spur growth. Yet the economy is not showing a clear rise in unemployment and inflation has not re‑accelerated, leaving the Fed without an urgent trigger to act now.

Cooling inflation gives the Fed more reason to wait. The U.S. labor market is not booming; real wages adjusted for inflation have fallen over the past six months and job growth is weak, though the unemployment rate remains at a historically low 4.1%. Earlier this year, the U.S.–Israel conflict with Iran pushed energy prices higher and spiked inflation, but price pressures have eased over the past two months.

The Fed‑preferred personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index, after three months of war‑driven energy price spikes, rose to 4.1% in May and fell back to 3.7% in June. While still far above the Fed’s 2% goal, the downward trend weakens the argument that “no rate hike means inflation cannot be lowered.”

The latest data further support a wait‑and‑see stance. July’s producer price index (PPI) was unexpectedly flat month‑over‑month, and the consumer price index (CPI) rose only modestly, after a dip in June. Recent weaker‑than‑expected job numbers, combined with CPI and PPI below forecasts, have led traders to pull back bets on a rate hike at the September 15‑16 meeting.

Richmond Fed President Thomas Barkin said many officials believe the current rate level remains sufficiently restrictive to keep inflation falling. Recent price accelerations stem largely from higher tariffs, rising oil prices and an AI investment boom, all of which may eventually recede.

Barkin also noted that media, markets and the public focusing on the recent cooling of inflation helps anchor price expectations. As long as the market continues to receive the message that “inflation is easing,” even though inflation has been above the Fed’s target for more than five years, the urgency for an immediate hike could diminish.

Hawkish officials worry that persistently high inflation could embed higher price expectations among consumers and firms, creating a self‑fulfilling cycle. If firms expect future cost increases, they may raise prices early; if consumers believe high inflation will continue, they may demand higher wages and alter spending, making price pressures harder to eliminate.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller and Lisa Cook recently said they would back a hike if inflation does not cool quickly. Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack went further, questioning whether a three‑ to four‑year timeline to bring inflation down to 2% would be acceptable.

Hammack was one of three voting Fed officials last month who opposed keeping the policy rate in the 3.50%‑3.75% range and advocated an immediate hike. Two other regional Fed presidents without voting rights later also voiced support for a rate increase this year.

Citing a Cincinnati retailer, Hammack said firms are pre‑emptively raising prices because, even if they don’t know the next source of cost pressure, they expect price hikes to come. She argues the Fed should act now to pull inflation back to 2% faster than the current gradual decline.

Tim Duy, chief U.S. economist at SGH Macro Advisors, warned that the longer inflation stays at current levels, the more it can become entrenched in public expectations. If markets stop believing the 2% target is achievable, the Fed will later have to pay a higher price and take stronger measures to restore credibility.

Warsh has not disclosed his next policy move and has avoided giving clear forward guidance. Trump continues to demand large cuts and blames “hostile” colleagues inside the Fed for blocking rate cuts. Yet there is little data suggesting the economy is weak enough to warrant the deep cuts Trump wants.

The Fed’s dilemma is that raising rates could dampen economic activity and lift unemployment while inflation may already be on a downward path; but staying put for too long could erode public confidence in the 2% goal.

Fed officials will release updated economic and rate forecasts after the September meeting. As of mid‑June, most projected PCE inflation to fall to 2.2%‑2.5% by the end of 2027, but only half of Warsh’s colleagues think at least one more 25‑basis‑point hike is needed before year‑end, while the rest, except one, see rates staying unchanged, highlighting deep division.

Christopher Hodge, chief U.S. economist at Natixis, said unexpected hikes remain possible at upcoming Fed meetings, but with inflation slowly edging toward target, consumer demand cooling and a fragile employment outlook, the Fed should ultimately be able to avoid further hikes. This suggests that under Warsh’s leadership the Fed may neither raise rates nor cut them at Trump’s urging, opting instead for an extended period of observation between the two risks.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉零售銷售降溫削弱Fed升息預期！主要指數漲跌互現
paras: 美股主要指數周五(14日)開盤走勢分歧，標普500指數在前一交易日創下收盤新高後變動不大，有望連續第三周收紅。美國7月零售銷售意外下滑，進一步削弱市場對聯準會(Fed)9月升息的押注，但投資人仍密切評估中東局勢與能源價格上漲風險。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近30點或近0.1%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近20點或0.06%，標普 500 指數漲0.02%，費城半導體指數跌近0.6%。台積電 ADR 跌近0.8%。
美股周五盤前維持在歷史高點附近，人工智慧(AI)交易熱度回升，加上最新經濟數據促使市場下調聯準會(Fed)升息預期，支撐風險資產買氣。不過，伊朗局勢與荷姆茲海峽航運風險仍可能推高能源價格，為通膨與市場前景增添變數。
截稿前，標普500指數期貨上漲0.1%，該指數周四甫創下收盤新高；那斯達克100指數期貨上漲0.3%，本周漲幅可望達到1.2%。記憶體業者Sandisk(SNDK-US)獲摩根大通調升評等後，盤前上漲近6%，投資人同時關注OpenAI赴華爾街上市的相關計畫。

AI資金重新湧入科技硬體

科技股本月推動標普500指數屢創新高，投資人重新布局先前遭到拋售的半導體與其他AI概念股。相關企業第二季財報普遍優於市場原本已相當樂觀的預期，使投資焦點重新回到實際營收與獲利成長。
美國銀行(BofA)由Michael Hartnett領軍的策略師團隊表示，市場多頭進一步推升風險資產的「大門已經敞開」，主要支撐因素包括企業獲利飆升、2026年家庭財富增加10兆美元，以及2027年AI資本支出預計超過1兆美元。
被視為AI投資風向球的南韓綜合股價指數(Kospi)周五上漲逾2%，本周累計大漲11%，終止連續7周下跌。三星電子與SK海力士過去5個交易日均上漲逾15%，反映資金重新追捧AI硬體與記憶體類股。
Asset Management One首席策略師Hitoshi Asaoka表示，大量超大規模雲端服務商資金正流入硬體領域，並轉化為硬體公司的強勁營收與獲利成長。投資人因而重新將注意力放在企業基本面，而非只關注AI投資規模與估值疑慮。
貨幣政策預期也為股市提供支撐。美國7月零售銷售創逾一年最大降幅，加上本周公布的消費者與生產者物價數據均較溫和，強化Fed保持耐心的理由。對政策前景敏感的2年期美債殖利率下跌4個基點至4.11%，美元指數則下跌0.4%。

能源與長債殖利率仍藏風險

儘管市場風險偏好回升，能源價格再度推升通膨的威脅並未消失。布蘭特原油周五一度大漲近2%，其後回吐漲幅，降至每桶約87美元。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)表示，美方將對伊朗實施前所未有的「經濟孤立」，並配合持續封鎖伊朗港口，形成雙重打擊。
Plurimi Wealth投資長Patrick Armstrong警告，荷姆茲海峽短期內恐怕無法完全恢復正常運輸，市場對相關風險可能過於自滿。一旦原油供應再受干擾，能源價格上漲可能重新推升通膨，並迫使投資人重新評估Fed政策路徑。
美國周四標售30年期公債的得標殖利率升至25年來最高，也凸顯投資人要求更高的風險溢價，才願意為美國龐大財政赤字提供融資。長天期殖利率居高不下，可能對股票估值構成壓力。
《彭博》策略師Skylar Montgomery Koning指出，市場展現出驚人韌性，夏季行情可能以樂觀氣氛收尾，但表面平靜之下的尾部風險正持續擴大，尤其集中於大宗商品價格上漲、停滯性通膨及長天期債券殖利率攀升。
